title: Website & SEO Specialist (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Website & SEO Specialist (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Position Overview

The Website & SEO Specialist is responsible for increasing the organic and overall traffic of

the Sawit Pro website through technical SEO enhancements, strategic content

implementation, on-page/off-page optimization, and site experience improvements. This role

ensures the website is optimized for discoverability, speed, usability, and

conversion—supporting lead generation and brand visibility objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Ensure all content, visuals, and functionality on the Sawit Pro website is up-to-date, relevant, and aligned with campaign objectives.

Collaborate with developers and designers to improve site structure, UX/UI, and mobile responsiveness.

SEO Strategy & Implementation (Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Local SEO)

Perform keyword research and competitive analysis to find SEO opportunities and develop content plans.

Brief the content team on high-potential blog/article/video ideas based on search trends.

Track website traffic, page performance, bounce rate, average time on site, and keyword rankings using Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEO tools.

Report on SEO progress weekly and monthly with actionable insights and improvement plans.

Collaborate with the Online Marketing Manager to improve lead-generation paths.

Monitor and improve conversion rates through better UX, messaging clarity, and page structure.

Kualifikasi

Proficient in SEO tools: Google Search Console, SEMrush/Ahrefs, Screaming

Frog, Yoast/RankMath, Ubersuggest

Familiar with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager

Experience with WordPress or similar CMS platforms

Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics is a plus

Strong analytical mindset, detail-oriented, and proactive in troubleshooting

Strategic thinker with an execution mindset

Self-driven and proactive with the ability to work independently

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Curious, growth-oriented, and up-to-date with SEO/website trends

Willing to be placed in Pekanbaru, Riau

Tentang Perusahaan

​

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack, Product (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack, Product (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead the development of responsive web applications (React, Angular, Vue), ensuring consistency in UX/UI and functionality.

Design, build, and maintain backend services in Go, delivering scalable, low-latency APIs that power web and mobile clients.

Architect scalable solutions across the full stack, ensuring maintainability, performance, and security while advocating for modular design patterns.

Mentor engineers in cross-platform development, backend design, code reviews, and testing strategies.

Partner with backend and infrastructure teams to design unified APIs (REST/GraphQL) and optimize data synchronization.

Champion Agile/Scrum rituals, refining sprint planning and retrospectives for cross-functional teams.

Monitor and troubleshoot production issues using analytics and observability tools.

Visit customers and collect user feedback to inform product improvements.

Contribute to technical innovation and optimization efforts across the stack.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

10+ years of experience in web, and/or backend development.

Strong proficiency in

JavaScript/TypeScript

for frontend development.

Proficiency in

Go

for building backend services and APIs.

Solid understanding of RESTful API design and OpenAPI Specification; GraphQL experience is a plus.

Experience with scalable databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data modeling.

Experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, etc.).

Knowledge of frontend and backend analytics and monitoring tools (e.g., Firebase, AppsFlyer, New Relic).

Experience with unit testing, automated testing, and TDD (Robot Framework is a plus).

Proficiency in Git and version control systems.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration abilities.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).

Willing to be placed in

Pekanbaru.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Senior Data Governance (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Senior Data Governance (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Develop and implement data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures that align with business goals and regulations

Lead the data governance council and coordinate across departments to drive governance initiatives

Set up and maintain data quality standards, metrics, and monitoring systems

Build and manage data catalogs, metadata repositories, and data lineage documentation

Create and oversee data stewardship programs with clear roles and accountability

Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations

Create and deliver data governance training for employees

Track and report on governance metrics, compliance, and program success

Spearhead data quality improvements and fixes

Work with IT teams to implement governance tools and technologies

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field

2+ years of experience in data governance, data management, or similar roles

Strong technical proficiency in data warehousing, ETL tools, SQL, and data modeling

Deep understanding of data governance frameworks, methodologies, and best practices

Proven experience implementing and managing enterprise-wide data governance programs

Comprehensive knowledge of data privacy regulations and compliance requirements

Demonstrated success working with senior stakeholders and driving organizational change

Exceptional project management and cross-functional team leadership abilities

Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities

Strong strategic thinking and planning abilities

Excellent communication and presentation skills

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: Senior Data Engineer
raw_description:
Senior Data Engineer

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Role

As a Data Engineer in the Lending Data Engineering team, you will collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders across Southeast Asia. This group includes data modelers, product analysts, product managers, software engineers, and business leaders. You will design and manage scalable, end-to-end data solutions across acquisition, storage, processing, and consumption. These solutions will utilize technologies like Flink, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, and Trino. You will report directly to the Data Engineering Manager, with a full-time onsite working arrangement in our Jakarta Office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Build and maintain scalable batch, real-time, and event-driven ETL pipelines using core AWS services (Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, S3, EMR, Kinesis, MSK).

Design and deploy modern data lifecycle frameworks supporting streaming, API-based, serverless, and batch consumption directly on the data lake.

Establish robust data checks, automated cleansing routines, and governance best practices using tools like AWS Glue DataBrew to ensure high data reliability.

Monitor, maintain, and optimize data platform infrastructure to guarantee high availability, low latency, and accurate, timely delivery of key business metrics.

Master and leverage in-house data platform tools alongside native AWS technologies to streamline pipeline setup, execution, and real-time metric tracking.

Collaborate across engineering teams to translate real-time data availability into actionable business definitions, driving data-informed decision-making.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

6+ years building scalable, fault-tolerant, and mission-critical data pipelines.

Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java; strong SQL, schema design, and data modeling skills.

Expertise in big data frameworks (Flink, Spark, Trino, Airflow, Kafka) across SQL, NoSQL, and Columnar databases.

Hands-on experience with AWS services (S3, EMR, Redshift, Athena, Glue, Kinesis) and event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, Lambda).

Experience for analytical. Experience communicating updates and resolutions to customers and other partners with a drive to learn and innovate.

Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack
raw_description:
Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Come join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team! We work on a diverse set of consumer problems. These problems span across core experiences that power the UX navigation and transaction funnels, search and discovery of content and services. They also cover the user lifecycle, including user growth, engagement, and loyalty. Additionally, they involve the critical platform mission of mobile application developer experience. We are on an exciting mission to connect consumers to Grab's marketplace by allowing them to discover and engage with Grab's services and partners.

Get to Know the Role

You will build high-quality systems that power end-to-end consumer journeys across the Grab app—from login to the home and activity experiences. You will promote AI-driven delivery, using AI-enabled engineering workflows to take well-defined requirements through planning, testing, debugging, and documentation to a review-ready merge request. You will ensure these workflows produce secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions while helping raise engineering standards across the team. You will report to the Engineering Manager. This is an on-site role based in Jakarta.

You will report to the Engineering Manager. This is an on-site role based in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Build, operate, and optimize scalable, high-availability fullstack services and Go backend systems.

Leverage and validate AI-assisted tools to build secure, high-quality code and lead plans that boost team efficiency.

Design scalable architectures, manage system performance and capacity, and resolve complex distributed system issues.

Take end-to-end ownership of product outcomes, drive cross-functional alignment, and manage production incidents during on-call rotations.

Elevate engineering standards through design/code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, IT, or related field

6+ years of software engineering experience.

Computer Science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, and system design).

Critical ability to audit AI-generated code for security, correctness, and maintainability.

title: Senior Engineer, Finance Systems
raw_description:
Senior Engineer, Finance Systems

Team

Technology Solutions

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

This is a hybrid engineering role for someone who builds autonomous, agentic AI systems and is comfortable integrating them into a live ERP landscape. You will design Large Language Model-based agents that plan, reason, and use tools. These agents will implement multi-step Finance and Procurement workflows with minimal human intervention. These agents will connect safely into Oracle Fusion processes. Your work will let us build AI-driven automation internally, promoting this capability directly alongside our Oracle developers.

You will work on site at our office in Jakarta, Indonesia.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Develop autonomous AI agents that plan, reason, and complete Finance and Procurement workflows across O2C, R2R, and P2P.

Integrate agents with Oracle Fusion Cloud, external APIs, and databases so they can take actions in production ERP processes.

Improve model and agent performance through prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.

Build evaluation and testing frameworks that measure agent reliability, accuracy, and safety.

Implement and maintain guardrails and human oversight for automated finance workflows.

Break down complex, multi-step business processes into components suitable for AI implementation.

Set technical direction and engineering standards, and guide peers on agentic AI and ERP integration patterns.

Read more

Skills you need

You will need

3+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years designing and building scalable systems.

AI engineering skills: Python, API design, and hands-on experience building with large language models.

Experience with AI/ML fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.

Backend proficiency across databases, microservices, and system architecture.

Experience deconstructing complex business tasks into steps an AI system can implement.

title: Assistant Manager, Technology Audit
raw_description:
Assistant Manager, Technology Audit

Team

Security

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to know our Team:

Group Internal Audit is an independent function within Grab (reporting to the Audit Committee) that provides objective assurance and advisory services to Grab's senior leaders. We use a systematic, disciplined risk-based approach to evaluate and assess Grab's risks, processes and internal controls. Reflecting Grab's entrepreneurial spirit, Group Internal Audit covers multiple businesses and technology areas. If you're seeking a chance to delve into and execute technology audits within a dynamic, rapidly evolving tech firm, with exposure to cutting-edge technologies, our team is the perfect fit for you!

Get to know the Role:

We are seeking an Assistant Manager / Manager of Technology Audit, to be based in South Jakarta. In this role, you will be responsible for the effective execution of audits, risk advisory and SOX testing activities related to Technology across Grab's businesses. You will work alongside a team of technology auditors, performing audits, risk advisories and SOX testing across Grab's product, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and technology processes. We are looking for a candidate with excellent audit and risk advisory experience to complement our Technology Audit team in our fast-paced, dynamic environment. Your role will involve designing audit work steps to evaluate risks associated with governance, financial, operational, regulatory, and business continuity.

The day-to-day activities:

Collaborate with the Technology Audit team and other teams within Group IA, focusing on all risks arising from Technology activities across Grab's businesses.

Plan and perform risk-based assessments, understand and evaluate the business environment, related technology controls and processes.

Prepare and present audit findings in draft/ final reports.

Assess deficiencies identified, work with stakeholders to identify action plans and follow-up on remediation activities to verify resolution

Develop and maintain relationships with Grab's leaders, acting as a trusted risk advisor on control-related matters.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science/ Engineering, Accountancy, Finance or equivalent. Professional certification (e.g., CISA, CISM, CISSP) is advantageous.

Minimum of 5 years of technology audit and risk advisory experience, including Sarbanes-Oxley.

Experience in auditing applications, cybersecurity domains, infrastructure and/ or cloud computing.

Experience with data analytics and visualisation tools.

Excellent command of English.

title: Officer-HBB Planning & Profitability
raw_description:
Job Purpose

Support the HBB Market Planning & Insight function by delivering data analysis, market intelligence, and profitability tracking, enabling accurate planning and effective decision-making.

 

Key Responsibilities:

1. Market Intelligence & Data Collection

  • Collect, validate, and maintain market data, competitor intelligence, and field insights.
  • Support development of desktop studies and planning models.
  • Conduct and deliver regular competitor analysis reports.

2. Network Planning Support

  • Execute desktop analysis to identify and propose RFS locations based on defined criteria.
  • Align planning outputs with actual market conditions and field inputs.
  • Support continuous improvement of site selection methodology.

3. Profitability Analysis

  • Perform regular profitability analysis by partner, cluster, and cohort.
  • Track performance against business targets and highlight key variances and insights.
  • Support preparation of business cases and financial evaluations.

4. Data Management & Reporting

  • Maintain and update home-passes database with high accuracy and integrity.
  • Ensure availability of data for dashboards, reporting, and analysis.
  • Support development of automated reporting tools.

5. Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor post-RFS performance, including take-up rate, revenue, and payback metrics.
  • Identify underperforming areas and support root cause analysis.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations for performance improvement initiatives.

6. Portfolio Optimization Support

Evaluate existing home-passes and recommend maintain, optimize, or exit actions.

 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in analytics, planning, or telecom-related roles.
  • Strong proficiency in data analysis and Excel (or similar tools).

title: Sr Officer-RAN Capacity Program Management
raw_description:
Role Purpose

Reporting to the AVP Head of RAN Capacity Planning, the role holder will carry out 4G/5G RAN Network Capacity Planning and RAN Site database update and parameter standardization. The RAN Capacity Planning Program Management role is responsible for managing end-to-end radio access network (RAN) capacity planning and strategic expansion programs for 4G and 5G networks including FWA from RAN capacity point of view. The role ensures network readiness, service quality, and optimal user experience by aligning network capacity with traffic growth, business demand, and commercial priorities.

 

RAN Capacity Planning & Dimensioning

Develop nationwide and regional 4G/5G and FWA capacity plans based on traffic growth projections, subscriber trends, and business forecasts.

 

Program Management

Manage end-to-end implementation tracking for RAN capacity expansion programs

 

Special Program Management

Lead strategic or high-priority initiatives such as; Network modernization, Spectrum deployment, 5G SA preparation, FWA, etc

 

Stakeholder & Business Alignment

Collaborate closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to support business growth initiatives.

 

Qualification:

 

Minimum 5 Years Experience in strong exposure to nationwide telecommunication RAN Capacity Planning, Operations and Strategic projects

 

Related Experience:

    • RAN Planning
    • Capacity Management
    • RF Engineering
    • Network Strategy
    • Telecom Program Management

 

Skills:

Expertise in;

    • Huawei/Nokia ecosystems
    • RAN Planning Tools
    • Traffic forecasting tools
    • SQL/Python analytics (preferred)

title: AVP Core Finance Architect
raw_description:
Job Description

  • RESPONSIBLE for leading and owning the Oracle Fusion Finance capability, combining solution architecture and hands-on core finance expertise. This role ensures that finance processes, configurations, integrations, extensions, cloud services, and operational issues are properly designed, implemented, supported, and aligned with business, accounting, compliance, control, and enterprise architecture requirements
  • DEFINING, REQUIREMENT GATHERING, CONTINUOUSLY IMPROVING the Enterprise Support System (ESS) strategy, architecture and roadmap within the defined domain, Formulation of Solution Design and DELIVERY Business as Usual (BAU) Application and System Finance and Procurement Technology System within the defined domain.
  • DOMAIN is defined as all related CORE FINANCE System
  • Manage Flexibility of DELIVERY Methodology with AGILE and WATERFALL DELIVERY or OTHER Methodology of application and system Delivery for business and system enhancements include Release Management.
  • MANAGEMENT of Application Developers, Vendor Partners, Budgetary Plan (Man-Days) including propose, review, approve solution / effort and Operational Leadership
  • DEVELOP high-level use-case of the solution which represents the value of the proposed solution in terms of investment and cost of resources required for the desired business outcomes.
  • Adoption of Agility Principle in delivery process to reduce bureaucracy in approval process, accelerate development and delivery quality.
  • INTERFACE to all stakeholders internal and external (B2C, B2B, Sales & Distribution, Digital, Finance, Cust Service, Customer Experience, Marketing, Network, Regional, IT Investment, IT Planning, Project, Operation, Infrastructure), External Parties - Bank, Payment Gateway, Manage Vendors or Partner, etc. )
  • KEEP UP with global trends and technology update, Deep UNDERSTAND business direction and DEVELOP principles and selection method accordingly for the most suitable partner and technology.
  • DEVELOP high-level use-case of the solution which represents the value of the proposed solution in terms of investment and cost of resources required; the desired business outcomes.
  • INITIATE annual budgetary plan which includes budgetary of new capabilities, capacity expansion, features enhancement and system transformation.
  • Work to REDUCE or REMOVE BOTTLENECKS and INEFFICIENCIES in the Delivery as a whole.

 

Qualification:

  • Minimum University Degree (S1), with major study in Informatics / Computer / Telecommunication Engineering.
  • Oracle Fusion certification is an advantage.

Related Experience:

Has experience at minimum 5 years in telecommunication industry, especially in Finance and Procurement Technology and Enterprise technology roadmap design, solution and delivery would be an advantage.

Skills

 

General Skillset:

  • Excellent communication in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.
  • Excellent technical writing and reporting.
  • Excellent presentation and persuasion skills.
  • Excellent knowledge of telecommunication business in general.
  • Excellent understanding of general and specific business processes within the business users.
  • Excellent knowledge of IT system landscape and technology roadmap.
  • Excellent in analytical thinking
  • Capable of working independently and as a member of team
  • Time Management abilities
  • Problem-solving skills
  • Customer focus

 

Specific Skillset (Domain):

  • Has an excellent knowledge of Core Finance system, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
  • Strong expertise in Enterprise Architecture Oracle Fusion Financials.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Tax, Intercompany, Closing, and financial reporting.
  • Good understanding of Oracle Cloud SaaS, PaaS, OIC, API, workflow, extensions, and cloud integration concepts.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles, finance operations, reconciliation, audit, and financial control.
  • Ability to design solutions as an architect and support detailed functional configuration as an expert.
  • Strong analytical capability for issue resolution, impact assessment, and continuous improvement.
  • Has an Excellent knowledge of Agile Framework and Waterfall Methodology
  • Extensive experience in managing end-to-end demand lifecycle process (requirement, solution and delivery), budget, governance and resources.
  • Has an Excellent end to end Delivery Management (Project Management / Scrum Master / Vendor Management)
  • Very good understanding of the overall system architecture and end to end system integration, IT application and system solution and design, database design, infrastructure design and services of the telco
  • Very good understanding of the system bucket man-days management, review, optimize and approve bucket to keep budget stability.
  • Has a good knowledge in Infrastructure in the area of server, storage, database, cloud & virtualization, backup system, desktop, local/wide area network, data center and disaster recovery.Has a good knowledge of Business Process Framework, Application Framework and Information Framework.

title: AVP-Telco Cloud Architecture, Automation & Services
raw_description:
Job Summary

The Telco Cloud Core Architect & Automation and services  is responsible for defining and driving the architecture of the cloud-native core platform while shaping the company’s API strategy to enable scalable, secure, and interoperable services. This role ensures alignment between cloud infrastructure, 4G/5G core evolution, digital platforms, and API products—enabling faster innovation, improved service exposure, and ecosystem growth.

The role collaborates with Engineering, TechCo, Product, IT/Digital, Cybersecurity, and external partners to build an architecture that accelerates digital services, supports network modernization, and unlocks new monetization opportunities through APIs

Key Responsibitliy

Key Responsibilities

Key Result Areas

Design and govern cloud‑native core architecture (EPC, IMS, 5G Core, UDM, PCF, NEF).

Stable, scalable cloud-native core platform

Define architecture patterns for CNFs/NFVs (e.g. Openstack, Kubernetes), network slicing, edge cloud, and distributed compute.

Deliver complete target-state and transition-state architecture maps aligned to the technology roadmap.

Create long-term roadmap and implementation plans for Telco cloud infrastructure

Strategic alignment and modernization readiness

Define the company’s API strategy covering: 

  • Network APIs (NEF, CAPIF/3GPP, CAMARA)
  • Enterprise APIs (B2B exposure)
  • Internal service APIs for microservices

Alignment with GSMA Open Gateway standards.

 

Lead API governance, standards, and lifecycle management (design, versioning, documentation, deprecation).

Consistent API governance and high adoption across internal/partner ecosystems.

 

 

Key Responsibility_2

Oversee API gateways, service mesh, identity, and access frameworks (OAuth2/OIDC/MTLS).

Robust, secure, and scalable API platform supporting Telco API monetization

Partner with Product teams to translate network capabilities into monetizable APIs.

Faster launch of network and digital services.

 

Drive automation (IaC, CI/CD, GitOps) and cloud reliability (SRE, observability).

Reduce time for changes through optimized CI/CD workflows

Ensure platform security, compliance, resilience, and Zero Trust principles.

Implement Zero Trust controls across identity, workload, and network layers with full policy coverage.

Maintain architecture blueprints, reference models, and decision records.

Publish and update architecture blueprints quarterly with version control and stakeholder sign-off.

Lead vendor evaluation, architecture reviews, and technology roadmaps.

 

Conduct Architecture Review Boards with ≥90% project compliance to standards. 

Complete vendor evaluations with standardized scoring, benchmarks, and TCO for 100% major procurements.

 

Skills

  • Strong experience in cloud-native telco core (EPC, 5G Core SA, IMS, UDM, PCF, NEF). 
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, containers, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), and distributed systems. 
  • Strong understanding of API frameworks (REST, gRPC), gateways, OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, rate limiting, throttling. 
  • Familiarity with GSMA Open Gateway / CAMARA and CAPIF architecture. 
  • Proficiency with IaC (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD, GitOps. 
  • Strong grasp of cloud networking (BGP, CNI, overlay networks). 
  • Understanding of SRE practices and cloud observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger).

Leadership Competency

 

Competency

Definition

Expected Behavior

Technology Vision

Shapes cloud-native evolution roadmap

Defines cloud stack direction for on-prem Telco Core workloads

Innovation & Automation

Drives automation in operations

Delivers scalable, resilient, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure

Execution Oversight

Ensures timely delivery of infrastructure goals

Tracks infra delivery milestones, issue resolution, and performance optimization

API Strategy Leadership

Leads API enablement and adoption

Develop robust frameworks for Telco API infrastructure and exposure

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborates across teams and vendors

Drives alignment and smooth integration across domains and suppliers

Operational Discipline

Ensure system stability and compliance

Embeds governance, monitoring, and security standards

Infrastructure Strategy

Guides to hardware and orchestration technology choices

Selects optimal platform combinations for performance, efficiency, and cost

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field
  • 8–15+ years in network/cloud architecture or platform engineering. 
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale cloud-native telco systems. 
  • Experience designing or leading API ecosystems (internal or external). 
  • Proven leadership in multi-vendor, cross-functional environments.
  • Experience initiating or leading AI-based network operations and automation projects in cloud, SDN, or Telco Core domains
  • Familiarity with multi-vendor Telco environments, open-source ecosystems, and hardware platform benchmarking
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure hardware design including x86, ARM, and AMD platforms, as well as NIC technologies, DPDK, and high-performance network interface requirements
  • Strong analytical and architectural thinking, 
  • Ability to communicate complex material to both technical and business stakeholders. 
  • Proactive leadership, vendor management, and decision-making. 
  • Excellent documentation and modelling (UML, ArchiMate).

title: Head of Customer Acquisition & Fulfillment
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The Head of Customer Acquisition & Fulfillment owns the end-to-end journey of a sold order into an active FTTH service — from customer verification and validation through to installation, activation, and service delivery. This is an AVP-level role leading two functions, Verification & Validation and Service Delivery, and is accountable for ensuring genuine customer acquisition, preventing fraud/recycle-customer cases, and delivering the installation and activation experience promised at the point of sale. The role plays a critical part in protecting revenue integrity and driving FTTH's targets for interaction volume, First Call Resolution (FCR), and Customer Care CSAT, by ensuring orders are fulfilled right the first time and customers become genuine, satisfied subscribers.

 

Scope of Work

Customer Acquisition (Verification & Validation)

-  Lead the Verification & Validation team to confirm FTTH service availability at the customer's location against coverage maps/databases and required infrastructure.

-  Ensure every prospective customer is validated as a genuine customer prior to onboarding, preventing recycle-customer / fraud cases.

-  Set, monitor, and continuously improve verification SLA and accuracy targets; escalate coverage or infrastructure gaps to Technology/Network partners.

 

Order Fulfillment & Service Delivery

-  Lead the Service Delivery function across order management, installation scheduling, site preparation, installation/activation, and quality assurance (interim coverage while the dedicated Head of Service Delivery role is vacant).

-  Ensure customer orders progress smoothly from sale through activation, coordinating with Sales, Billing, Technical, and Field Partner teams.

-  Own installation SLA performance, activation turnaround time, and first-time-right installation quality.

 

End-to-End Order-to-Activation Ownership

-  Act as the single point of accountability for the full journey from sold order to a genuine, verified, and successfully installed/activated service.

-  Build and maintain an integrated reporting cadence covering verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, and CSAT.

-  Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks between the acquisition (verification) and fulfillment (installation/activation) stages.

 

People Management

-  Lead and develop the Verification & Validation and Service Delivery teams, setting clear KPIs and measuring performance regularly.

-  Own team structure and tasks, recruitment, performance management, team building, succession planning, mentoring, and training.

-  Provide feedback through 1:1s, personal development plans, and coaching to build a strong pipeline for the future Service Delivery headcount

 

Partner Management

title: AVP-Data Integration
raw_description:
Role:

Responsible for leading the definition, development, continuous improvement, and delivery of enterprise data integration capabilities across Data Analytics platforms. The role acts as a senior individual contributor and technical platform owner for data integration, ensuring that data solutions are reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with business outcomes.

Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration architecture, data pipelines, data warehouse interfaces, data marts, and data exchange mechanisms between operational systems, analytical platforms, cloud platforms, and reporting/BI solutions.

 

Qualification:

Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Telecommunication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or other relevant technical disciplines. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in cloud/data engineering is an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5–8 years of total experience in data engineering, data integration, Big Data, Data Warehouse, cloud data platform (GCP), or digital technology delivery.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data integration architecture, ETL/ELT development, cloud data platform implementation (GCP), DWH/data mart development, or large-scale data pipeline delivery.
  • Strong experience in managing end-to-end project delivery for telecom operator, enterprise data platform, or complex digital technology environment.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery and/or structured project management methodology, including planning, estimation, risk management, delivery tracking, and production readiness.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, security/privacy, observability, and cost optimization / FinOps practices is preferred.

Working knowledge of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and real-time analytics use cases is an advantage.

 

Skills:

The role is expected to have sufficient hands-on technical depth to review, guide, and challenge engineering implementation, while primarily focusing on architecture ownership, technical governance, delivery assurance, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration capabilities.

 

General Skillset:

  1. Strong understanding of telecommunications business processes, enterprise IT landscape, data-driven business operations, and the role of data platforms in supporting commercial, finance, network, customer, digital, and regulatory use cases.
  2. Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capability to translate business problems into data integration requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  3. Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills to work effectively with business users, BI teams, data governance, enterprise architects, IT project owners, security, operations, vendors, consultants, and system integrators.

 

Must-have Skillset and Technology Expertise:

  1. Data Integration Architecture: Strong capability in integration pattern selection, batch/incremental/near-real-time pipeline design, interface specification, data exchange mechanism, orchestration design, dependency management, resiliency pattern, and production readiness review.
  2. ETL/ELT and Data Engineering: Hands-on experience designing, developing, reviewing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines using GCP Platform, SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, shell scripting, Talend, IBM DataStage, Apache Nifi, DBT, and/or equivalent enterprise data integration tools.
  3. Cloud Data Platform and BigQuery: Strong knowledge of GCP data services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, IAM, service account management, monitoring, logging, and cloud networking concepts relevant to data platforms.
  4. Data Warehouse and Data Mart: Strong understanding of enterprise DWH, ODS, staging layer, data mart, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schema, historical data handling, slowly changing dimensions, aggregation, semantic layer, reconciliation, and BI/reporting consumption patterns.
  5. SQL, Programming, and Troubleshooting: Strong capability in SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, API integration concepts, code review, transformation logic assessment, query/job optimization, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and development standard definition.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Senior Process, Automation, Control & Optimization Engineer
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.

 

We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:

 

Job Title: Senior Process, Automation, Control & Optimization Engineer

 


Purpose:

To be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing process control strategies, automation systems, and advanced process optimization solutions to maximize plant performance, reliability, and safety. The role supports engineering design, commissioning, and operational improvement of production facilities.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

 

Process Engineering & Optimization

·         Analyze and optimize process performance to improve production efficiency, throughput, and energy utilization.

·         Develop and implement process control strategies to maintain stable and optimal operations.

·         Perform process simulations, modelling, and performance analysis to support plant improvements.

·         Identify and troubleshoot process bottlenecks and operational inefficiencies.

·         Support debottlenecking and plant optimization initiatives.

 

Automation & Control Systems 

·         Design and implement automation architectures and control strategies for production facilities.

·         Configure and optimize Distributed Control System (DCS), Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems.

·         Develop Advanced Process Control (APC) strategies, including:

o   Model Predictive Control (MPC)

o   Multivariable control

o   Real-time optimization

·         Develop control narratives, cause & effect matrices, and functional design specifications.

 

Control System Design & Engineering   

·         Review and approve:

o   Control philosophies

o   Instrumentation diagrams

o   Control system architecture

o   Control logic diagrams

·         Ensure integration between:

o   Process systems

o   Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS)

o   Plant automation systems

 

Operational Support & Troubleshooting

·         Provide technical support to operations teams during plant operations.

·         Troubleshoot issues related to:

o   Process upsets

o   Control system instability

o   Automation failures

·         Analyze plant data to identify improvement opportunities.

 

Commissioning & Startup Support

·         Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).

·         Participate in pre-commissioning, commissioning, and plant startup activities.

·         Verify control system performance and tuning of control loops.

 

Data Analytics & Digital Optimization

·         Utilize data analytics and digital tools for process monitoring and optimization.

·         Implement real-time monitoring systems and digital performance dashboards.

·         Support digitalization initiatives and smart plant technologies.

 

Project Engineering Support

·         Collaborate with:

o        Process engineers

o        Instrumentation engineers

o        Electrical engineers

o        Operations teams

·         Provide input during FEED, detailed engineering, and project execution phases.

·         Ensure automation systems meet project and operational requirements.

 

HSE & Risk Management

·         Ensure comply with:

o        Process safety standards

o        Functional safety requirements

o        Company engineering standards

·         Participate in HAZOP, SIL verification, and risk analysis studies.

 


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·         Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.

·         Report all incidents.

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives.

·         Education: Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, Control Engineering, or other equivalent subject

·         Experience:

o   Minimum of 15 years of working experience in Oil & Gas industry

o   Minimum of 10 years of working experience in oil & gas, offshore facilities, refineries, LNG, or petrochemical plants.

o   Strong knowledge of Process Control theory, advanced process control, real-time optimization.

·         Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

 


Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

·         Advanced process control expertise

·         Automation system integration

·         Analytical problem-solving

·         Operational troubleshooting

·         Cross-disciplinary coordination

 


Non-Technical Competencies:

·         Strong analytical and problem-solving capability

·         Technical leadership within multidisciplinary teams

·         Vendor and contractor coordination

·         Effective communication with project stakeholders

·         Risk-based decision-making

·         Strong leadership skills

 


Working Conditions:

·         Jakarta, Indonesia

·         Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - ORF Engineering Site Representative
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: ORF Engineering Site Representative



 

Purpose:

To serve as the owner/operator's technical and engineering authority on site at the Onshore Receiving Facility (ORF). To review and approve the specification, design, procurement, fabrication, installation, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and supply (by contractors) of all equipment, facilities, and systems in onshore receiving facilities. Ensuring that the engineering package is in conformance with schedule, project specifications, standards, codes, procedures, scope of work, design parameters, industry practices, P&IDs, line list, stress information, and vendor data.



General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

·         Liaise with others in the design team, construction team, subcontractors, vendors, and other related stakeholders

·         Prepare the engineering package including specifications, pre-commissioning and commissioning procedures

·         Develop and review the bill of material (BOM) and Material Take-Offs (MTO) against field requirements

·         Draw and update material and stress sketches

·         Attend CAD model as required and perform 3D clash/interference checks for constructability

·         Prepare and develop 2D/3D designs and review contractor engineering deliverables

·         Internal design and subcontracted design supervision

·         Develop and review the Material selection and specification

·         Estimate cost and schedule

·         Review, process, and resolve Technical Queries (TQ), Requests for Information (RFI), and Field Change Requests (FCR) on-site to resolve technical issues promptly.

·         Conduct daily site walkdowns to ensure constructability, resolve design-to-field clashes, and verify pipe routing and equipment layouts.

·         Manage and verify site redline markups to ensure accurate final As-Built drawings (P&IDs, Isometrics, Civil/Structural/Electrical layouts).

·         Witness critical site activities including hydrotesting, pneumatic testing, loop checks, equipment alignment, bolt tensioning, and pre-start-up safety reviews (PSSR).

·         Log and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), manage site punch lists (A/B/C items), and ensure resolution before facility handover.

·         Coordinate on-site equipment vendor specialists during installation, testing, and initial start-up Coordinate engineering activities for SPS and UMB work packages during FEED, detailed engineering, fabrication, and installation phases.

 


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·         Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.

·         Report all incidents.

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:


·         Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Civil, or Petroleum Engineering, or other equivalent subjects.

·         Experience:

o   Minimum 10 years of working experience in Onshore/ORF facilities area within Oil & Gas industry.

o   Minimum 5 years of working experience in site engineering, piping design, or construction oversight in major upstream projects

o   Have experience in Subsea interface and FPU interface or FPSO interface

·         Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

 


Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

·         Comprehensive construction methodology for Onshore Receiving Facilities (slug catchers, pressure vessels, gas separation, gas treatment, compressor stations, flare systems, utility systems), subsea pipeline landfall interfaces, and civil/structural/E&I works. Interface with subsea facility, pipelines, and FPSO/FPU.

·         Site Material & Equipment Management, Contractor Performance Monitoring, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), Technical Query (TQ) workflows, Construction Progress Measurement, and Management of Change (MOC).

·         Local / National Standards (Ditjen MIGAS, SKK Migas) and International Codes & Standards (ASME B31.3/B31.8, ASME Sec VIII, API 1104, API 510/570, AWS D1.1, NACE, NFPA), Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) standards.

·         Advanced knowledge of structural erection, piping fit-up/welding, NDT interpretation, hydrotesting/pneumatic testing, heavy equipment rigging/lifting, electrical/instrumentation loop testing, pre-commissioning, and Mechanical Completion (MC) handover.

·         Look-ahead scheduling, progress tracking (S-curves), cost/change control, Punch List management, As-Built documentation, and Data Book compilation.

·         Working proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), MS Project, AutoCAD, Navisworks / 3D Model Review tools, and EDMS platforms.

 


Non-Technical Competencies:

·         Must have excellent interpersonal, writing and communication skills

·         Ability to work well within multidisciplinary teams

·         Proactive in information gathering

·         High attention to detail and orderliness

 


Working Conditions:

·         Jakarta, Indonesia

·         Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Document Control Officer (TPC)
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.

 

We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Document Control Officer

 

Purpose:

·         To maintain project documents and ensure accurate information distribution within the project team.

·         To manage all project data and documentation, both electronic and hard copy, in line with company procedures.

·         To develop project data and document control procedures in order to guarantee traceability of all documents.

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

·         Monitor and control project documentation according to company document control procedures.

·         Prepare the Project Data and Document Management procedure, identify relevant company standards, and verify their proper application. 

·         Provide support to Project Team in preparing the Provisional List of Documents and in defining their relevant planning and programming.

·         Monitor data and technical documentation during the all lifecycle of the project.

·         Ensure that all technical documentation produced on behalf of the project is in accordance with the project requirements and traceable.

·         Retrieve any significant reference documentation of similar existing projects. 

·         Maintain and update the Project Document Register in parallel with the status of the company EDAM database system.

·         Issue and diffuse monthly reports on Document Production Status and the latest revision of the Document List.

·         Expedite consignment/return of documents and monitor their physical progress.

·         Manage document distribution according to the Project Document Distribution Matrix and ensure documents are shared at key times to facilitate timely project completion.

·         Ensure documents are available both in the Project Filing Cabinets (hard copy) and in the Company DMS (electronic file).

·         Prevent access to obsolete documentation.

·         Provide support for the handover of final documentation

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·         Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.

·         Report all incidents.

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

·         Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or other equivalent subjects.

·         Experience:

o   Minimum 5 years of working experience in a major Oil and Gas Company, Engineering Company, or Construction Company (offshore and onshore), with minimum 3 years of working experience as Project Document Control.

o   Minimum 3 years of working experience with contractors and supervising the contractors is preferred.

·         Training & Certification: Certificate in IT and/or Business Administration would be an advantage. 

·         Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

 

Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

·         Proven knowledge and understanding of the structure of Engineering and Project Documentations, Close-Out Reports, Project Management Methodologies and Techniques, Vendor Data Books, and Tendering Processes.

·         Good degree of computer literacy in Microsoft Office (Excel, Access)

·         Strong abilities to read, understand, interpret, and write reports and documentation.

 

Non-Technical Competencies:

·         Problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve control system issues during offshore activities.

·         Effective communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with cross-functional teams

·         Flexibility

·         Innovation

·         Excellence Orientation

·         Work Independently

·         Adaptive

 

Working Conditions:

·         Jakarta, Indonesia

·         Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas.

title: Medco E&P Indonesia - Expeditor
raw_description:
Medco E & P Indonesia is looking for an experienced Expeditor to join our team through a Third-Party Contract (TPC). In this role, you will contribute to Sakakemang PSC, an upstream oil and gas project located in South Sumatra and operated by MedcoEnergi. Currently in the development phase, the project is progressing toward First Gas/First Production, with start-up targeted for Q3 2027.


In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring, coordinating, and expedite the procurement, fabrication, inspection, delivery, and documentation of project materials and equipment to ensure timely availability in support of gas pipeline construction, commissioning, and achievement of the First Gas milestone.



Key Responsibilities


  • Monitor and track the progress of procurement activities, from purchase order issuance through delivery and close-out.
  • Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely fulfillment of project requirements.
  • Follow up on the status of material, equipment, and service deliveries and proactively address potential delays.
  • Monitor vendors' progress against agreed schedules and identify risks that may impact project timelines.
  • Expedite the submission, review, and approval of required vendor documentation.
  • Coordinate inspection, testing, and quality-related activities as required to support timely delivery.
  • Liaise with logistics and warehousing personnel to ensure smooth transportation and receipt of materials.
  • Maintain accurate expediting records and provide periodic progress reports to management and project teams.
  • Support the resolution of procurement and delivery issues through effective communication and coordination with relevant parties.
  • Ensure all expediting activities are carried out in compliance with company procedures, contractual requirements, and project objectives.
  • Participate in vendor meetings and, when required, conduct vendor visits to verify progress and resolve outstanding issues.
  • Provide early warning and recommendations to mitigate risks that may affect project schedules, costs, or operational objectives.
  • Other tasks as assigned.
raw_requirements:
• Minimum bachelor’s degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in procurement expediting project supply chain, materials management, or logistics coordination.
  • Experience in oil & gas EPC projects, gas pipeline projects, production facilities, or related infrastructure projects is preferred.
  • Experience supporting commissioning and First Gas activities is an advantage.
  • Proven Knowledge of Procurement and Supply Chain Management processes.
  • Solid understanding of material tracking and expediting systems.
  • Knowledge of logistics, shipping, customs clearance, and transportation processes.
  • Ability to interpret Purchase Orders (PO), Material Requisitions (MR), Delivery Schedules, and Vendor Documentation.
  • Familiarity with project execution phases, including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and start-up.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.
  • Good negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Solid awareness of HSE and environmental considerations in logistics operations.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic site environment.
  • English B2 (Upper Intermediate) Level.

Disclaimer: The selected candidate will be engaged on a contract basis through a third-party company appointed by MedcoEnergi. This role supports MedcoEnergi's projects and business objectives, and is delivered in alignment with the Company's standards, governance, and operational requirements.

Head of Product (Jakarta)

Daftar Sekarang

Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Own and drive product strategy from

zero-to-one

, ensuring alignment with long-term product vision and company strategy, and communicate it clearly to stakeholders and users.

Lead

experimentation-driven product development

, including rapid prototyping, MVP launches, A/B testing, and iterative validation.

Define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps, ensuring milestones are delivered on time with measurable impact.

Discover user pain points through qualitative research and deep data analysis; collaborate closely with analytics teams to translate insights into actionable product decisions.

Prototype product functionality and collaborate with design/UX teams to deliver best-in-class user experiences.

Develop go-to-market strategies and partner with growth teams to drive adoption, engagement, and retention.

Apply

growth-hacking principles

to product development, focusing on scalable acquisition, activation, and monetization levers.

Be highly analytical and data-driven; define success metrics and continuously measure product performance.

Lead, coach, and develop product managers, designers, and analysts, fostering a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Proven experience working in agile development environments.

Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Exceptional problem-solving skills with structured and strategic thinking.

Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities across cross-functional teams.

Ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Business, or other related fields.

8+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of products from zero-to-one and scaling stages.

Strong track record in experimentation, growth initiatives, and data-led decision making.

Experience using Product Management tools (e.g. Trello, GitHub Issues, Google Drive).

Experience using Prototyping tools (e.g. Figma).

Familiarity with Data Analytics tools (e.g. Metabase, Google Analytics).

Experience in palm oil or agribusiness-related companies is preferred.

Nice to have: Background in top-tier management consulting and/or investment banking, with exposure to strategy, growth, due diligence, or complex business problem-solving.

Willing to undergo a 2-month probation period in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

The candidate’s responsibility will be to work closely with Head of Procurement, Head of Supply Chain, Sales & Finance team. You will be responsible for spearheading our procurement strategy, ensuring the acquisition of a diverse range of agricultural inputs at competitive prices (also including general procurement items required by the Company). Your expertise will be crucial in managing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, and aligning our procurement efforts with the broader business objectives to support growth and operational efficiency.

You will be responsible to:

Develop, implement, and continuously refine a comprehensive procurement strategy that encompasses all categories of agricultural inputs.

Conduct extensive market research to identify reliable suppliers across different agri input categories, ensuring a diverse supplier base.

Lead the procurement process from supplier evaluation and selection to contract negotiation, ensuring adherence to quality, cost, and delivery standards.

Foster strong, strategic relationships with key suppliers to guarantee the best value in terms of price, quality, and service.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including finance, operations, and sales, to integrate procurement plans with business objectives.

Manage and optimize procurement budgets, focusing on cost-saving initiatives without compromising on product quality or availability.

Establish and maintain quality standards for all procured agri inputs, working closely with suppliers to ensure compliance.

Oversee logistics and supply chain management for all agri inputs, ensuring efficient and timely availability to meet customer demands.

Stay ahead of industry trends, market dynamics, and new technologies that can influence our product offerings and procurement strategies.

Kualifikasi

You will demonstrate the following requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Agriculture, or related fields.

At least 7 years of proven experience in procurement, preferably within the agriculture or e-commerce sectors, with a focus on a wide range of agri inputs. Experience in Palm Oil Industry is a great advantage.

Exceptional negotiation skills and the capacity to foster long-term supplier relationships.

Strong analytical, strategic, and problem-solving abilities.

Comprehensive knowledge of the agri input market in Indonesia and globally.

Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken.

Proficient in the use of procurement software and advanced analytics tools.

Demonstrated leadership and team management capabilities, with exceptional communication and presentation skills.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

Ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

raw_description:

Event Organizer (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Summary

:

The Event Marketing Coordinator plays a crucial role in the promotion and execution of events related to a digital loyalty platform specific to the Palm Oil Industry, with a focus on the Upstream and Midstream sectors. This role involves planning and coordinating various marketing activities, including trade shows, conferences, webinars, and industry networking events. The Event Marketing Coordinator works closely with cross-functional teams, industry partners, and stakeholders to ensure successful event experiences that drive engagement and enhance the platform's visibility in the market.

Responsibilities:

Event Planning and Execution: Plan, coordinate, and execute events aligned with the marketing strategy and objectives of the digital loyalty platform in the Palm Oil Industry. This includes identifying suitable events, managing event logistics, coordinating with vendors, and ensuring timely execution.

Event Marketing: Develop and implement event marketing campaigns to promote events and generate attendance. Utilize various channels, such as email marketing, social media, and industry publications, to maximize event visibility and attract target audiences.

Collateral and Content Development: Create event-related collateral, such as brochures, presentations, and promotional materials. Collaborate with the marketing team to develop compelling event content, including speaker profiles, session descriptions, and educational resources.

Industry Networking: Establish and maintain relationships with industry associations, organizations, and influencers. Actively participate in industry networking events and build strategic partnerships to expand the platform's reach and enhance its industry presence.

Event Analysis and Reporting: Measure and evaluate event performance through post-event analysis. Analyze metrics, such as attendance, lead generation, and attendee feedback, to assess event success and provide insights for future event planning and optimization.

Budget Management: Develop event budgets, track expenses, and ensure adherence to allocated budgets. Negotiate contracts and agreements with vendors, venues, and service providers to maximize cost-effectiveness.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with the marketing team, sales team, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure event strategies align with overall marketing and business goals. Coordinate with internal teams to secure speaker participation, organize product demonstrations, and provide event support.

Project Management: Effectively manage multiple event projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, deliverables, and budgets are met. Employ project management methodologies to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve overall event experiences.

Kualifikasi

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in event management are a plus.

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in event planning, event marketing, or related roles. Experience in organizing and executing events within the Palm Oil Industry or a similar industry is highly desirable.

Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Palm Oil Industry, specifically the Upstream and Midstream sectors. Familiarity with industry events, trade shows, conferences, and key stakeholders is preferred.

Event Management: Demonstrated experience in event planning, logistics management, and execution. Proven ability to handle multiple events simultaneously, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.

Marketing and Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling event content and effectively communicate event details to diverse audiences. Proficiency in social media marketing and email marketing is desirable.

Relationship Building: Strong networking and relationship-building skills to engage with industry partners, vendors, and event participants. Ability to establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.

Analytical and Reporting Abilities: Proficiency in analyzing event data, generating reports, and extracting actionable insights. Strong attention to detail in tracking event metrics and measuring event success.

Budgeting and Financial Management: Experience in event budget development, expense tracking, and contract negotiation. Ability to manage budgets effectively and maximize cost-efficiency.

Creativity and Problem-Solving: Innovative thinking and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges, identify opportunities, and enhance event experiences. Ability to think strategically and deliver unique event concepts.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to adapt plans and strategies based on changing priorities and emerging industry trends.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

< Kembali

Software Engineer - Odoo Specialist, Product (Jakarta)

Daftar Sekarang

Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead and participate in various development projects for our products and services and be involved in all development-related aspects of our technical operations.

Architect and design application solutions for complex business requirements within the agricultural supply chain domain.

Develop and customise Python-based ERP solutions according to specifications, focusing on backend services, APIs, and data processing systems using any popular Python framework (Odoo preferred).

Integrate applications with server components and third-party services, including ERP systems and internal agricultural data platforms.

Perform system analysis, design, testing and documentation whenever necessary to ensure code quality and maintainability.

Implement unit testing and system integration following best practices in software development.

Maintain and enhance existing applications while solving complex performance and architectural challenges.

Provide technical support on on-call rotations and troubleshoot production issues.

Take initiatives for required changes in software development processes to manage overall quality and efficiency.

Kualifikasi

Possess at least a Bachelor's Degree, or Master's Degree in Computer Science / IT, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), or equivalent.

Possess at least 2 years working experience in Odoo development and deployment.

Strong knowledge of Python and programming concepts with proven expertise in developing scalable applications.

Complete understanding of Odoo framework and its basic flow, including:

Proven expertise in developing custom modules in Odoo

Deep knowledge of Odoo data models and ORM (Object-Relational Mapping)

Experience with latest versions of Odoo (v14, v15, v16+) and excellent debugging skills

Odoo techno-functional knowledge across core modules (Sales, Purchase, CRM, Accounts, Inventory, Fleet, HR, Payroll)

Odoo Integration and APIs:

Experience with Odoo External API and XML-RPC/JSON-RPC

Web services integration (REST and SOAP) with external systems

API development for third-party integrations

Experience in OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus

Experience working with Source Control (Git) and following best practices for version control and code collaboration.

Experience in working with Web services integration (REST and SOAP) and API's Response (JSON and XML). Experience in OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus.

Good discipline in writing unit tests and integration tests with testing frameworks like pytest.

Experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS is a plus.

Knowledge of Linux operating systems and command-line tools.

Experience in Finance and Accounting.

Experience with data processing and analytics tools relevant to agricultural data management.

Willing to be on a 1-year contract.

Willing to undergo a 2-month onboarding period in Pekanbaru

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

SawitPRO is expanding its operation supply chain team into Kalimantan and is building a strong talent pipeline to support our future growth. We are looking for passionate and driven professionals with experience in Supply Chain to join our Talent Pool.

Warehouse Team (Supply Chain Coordinator, Warehouse Operator, etc.)

Logistic Team (Transport and Hub, First Last Mile, etc.)

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain efficiency and effectiveness.

Strong understanding of supply chain principles and operational processes.

Good analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel.

Experience with ERP systems (Odoo) or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) is an advantage.

Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.

Willing to travel for business purposes when required.

Willing to be based in Kalimantan according to business needs.
