title: Software Engineer – Fullstack, Delivery Team (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Software Engineer – Fullstack, Delivery Team (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

You will join the KebunPRO Delivery Engineering team as an end-to-end owner of customer onboarding technical work, covering configuration, data migration, integration, and frontend enablement across the full delivery lifecycle for large estate-owner accounts, working alongside the Delivery Manager, Field Customer Support Engineers, and Product Engineering.

You will be responsible for:

Owning end-to-end technical delivery for assigned customer accounts, from kickoff and discovery through go-live and hypercare.

Configuring and setting up both backend services and frontend environments for new KebunPRO customer accounts.

Designing and executing data migration from customer legacy systems into KebunPRO, and building integrations with third-party or customer systems.

Building lightweight customer-specific UI configurations and dashboards, and preparing training and enablement materials.

Translating customer requirements gathered during discovery sessions into a concrete technical delivery plan across the stack.

Resolving defects across backend, frontend, and integration layers quickly during go-live and hypercare to keep implementation timelines on track.

Writing and maintaining technical documentation, API specifications, and configuration runbooks for each customer delivery.

Performing unit and integration testing across delivery-specific configurations, migrations, and integrations.

Collaborating with Product Engineering to escalate and resolve product-level gaps discovered during delivery.

Providing technical support on on-call rotations for customers in active delivery or hypercare

Kualifikasi

Possess at least an Advanced Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, or Master's Degree in Computer Science / IT, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), or equivalent.

At least 2 years of working experience across both frontend and backend development.

Good knowledge of and familiarity with ReactJS and TypeScript on the frontend, and Golang and PostgreSQL on the backend.

Experience with data migration, ETL processes, or system integration work is a strong plus.

Experience working with Source Control (Git).

Experience working with Webservices integration (REST and SOAP) and API responses (JSON and XML). Experience with OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus.

Good discipline in writing unit tests and integration tests.

Experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS is a plus.

Proficiency with AI-augmented software engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, or Antigravity to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.

Comfortable context-switching across the stack, with strong ownership instincts and the ability to work independently and directly with customers during time-boxed delivery engagements.

Must be analytical, a problem-solver, and comfortable operating under delivery deadlines.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Operations Analytics Assistant Manager
raw_description:
Operations Analytics Assistant Manager

Team

Business Strategy

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Merchant Operations is a team responsible for analyzing merchant growth and trends. We make critical decisions to serve the lives of merchant-partners and providing best offers for our consumers.

Get to Know the Role

We are looking for an

Operations Analytics Lead

to spearhead data-driven decision-making across our merchant strategy and control tower operations. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution—autonomously translating complex operational challenges into analytical models, automated dashboards, and actionable business insights.

You will own end-to-end analytics initiatives spanning merchant acquisition, incubation, and segmentation frameworks verticals. This is an Onsite role based in Jakarta

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Translate Business Goals to Analytical Roadmaps:

Autonomously identify operational bottlenecks and translate strategic merchant priorities into concrete analytical frameworks and end-to-end project deliverables.

Design & Own Core Strategic Analytics:

Drive foundational initiatives, including the annual review and revamp of Merchant Segmentation frameworks, metric thresholds, and acquisition funnel tracking (identifying merchant white spaces across GrabFood and GrabMart).

Deliver Actionable Business Insights:

Go beyond reporting data to uncover root causes and commercial trends (e.g., GMV variations, merchant density, conversion rates) and provide structured, executive-ready recommendations to leadership.

Build & Automate Scalable Dashboards:

Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust reporting pipelines and interactive dashboards from scratch to monitor cross-channel operations.

Maintain Data Integrity & Queries:

Write clean, efficient SQL queries, manage automated data transformation scripts in Python, and collaborate with engineering/data platform teams on database hygiene and lineage.

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team, where we tackle a diverse range of challenges across the user journey—from core navigation and transaction flows to content and service discovery, user engagement, and the mobile app developer experience.

Our mission is to create the best discovery and engagement experiences, earn customer loyalty, and meet people's everyday needs through seamless, personalized, and contextual experiences that maximize convenience and value for money.

Get to Know the Role

You'll design, build, and operate secure, reliable, and well-tested software systems. You'll make thoughtful choices about architecture and infrastructure, and monitor your work after it goes live.

You'll partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout product design and rollout, taking ownership and keeping projects moving. You'll also help the team grow by mentoring newer engineers and, especially at senior levels, improving team practices.

You will report to the Engineering Manager, and you will be based fully on-site in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Design, build, and maintain iOS SDK capabilities, native entry points, JavaScript bridges, and reusable APIs.

Improve SDK reliability, performance, security, observability, and backward compatibility across Grab app releases.

Drive iOS and Android capability parity by defining clear cross-platform contracts and consistent developer experiences.

Partner with backend engineers on Horus services, authentication, scopes, transaction capabilities, telemetry, and other platform integrations.

Build automated tests, release tooling, sample applications, and technical documentation that make partner integrations faster and safer.

Investigate production issues, strengthen monitoring and failure handling, and contribute to incident response and post-incident improvements.

Collaborate with product, design, QA, and partner teams to translate requirements into scalable mobile platform solutions.

Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and continuous improvement of engineering standards.

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Wallet Cash-In/Cash-out Experience team plays a crucial role in powering liquidity for Grab, providing seamless and smooth experiences for millions of customers across Southeast Asia. Our mission is to allow anyone, including the unbanked, to access digital cash quickly and affordably. Whether it's topping up wallets or cashing out funds, our systems ensure transactions happen smoothly.

Get to Know the Role

We are looking for a passionate Senior Backend Engineer with the required skills and more to join our payments team. You will offer exciting challenges, including the opportunity to lead groundbreaking architectural advancements. You will have opportunities to design backend components. You'll report to the Software Engineering Manager II. The working arrangement for this role is on-site.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will work within the payments covering Wallet Cash-In/Cash-out Experience, helping improve product engineering vision.

Build services that delight our customers through active participation in discovery sessions, continuous R&D

Explore and utilize Generative AI to enhance workflows and accelerate development velocity.

You will participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, performance tuning, and capacity planning

title: AVP-AI/ML Solution
raw_description:
Job Title:  AVP - AI/ML Solution

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Act as the primary interface between business leaders and the technical team, translating complex business needs into robust technical requirements and high-impact AI roadmaps
  • Lead the communication strategy to explain complex technical AI/ML concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders across the organization.
  • Ensure all deployed models and data pipelines maintain high accuracy, stability, and measurable business impact through rigorous experimentation frameworks
  • Oversee and guide the design, development, and production deployment of scalable AI/ML systems
  • Define model objectives and success metrics, ensuring all AI/ML initiatives directly drive CX uplift and revenue growth
  • Partner deeply with Network, Commercial, and Vendor Management teams to co-create AI-native solutions and champion data-driven decision-making across the organization

 

Requirements

 

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics or related field.
  • Minimum of 7–10+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning and  AI Solutions, with at least 2–3 years in a leadership, managerial, or principal consulting role (preferably within the telecommunications or consulting sector)
  • Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional teams to design, scale, and deliver complex data pipelines, ingestion architectures, and productionized AI products.
  • Deep, hands-on architectural familiarity with Multi-Agent systems and orchestration frameworks
  • Expert-level command of Python and deep experience across production frameworks like XGBoost, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Expert knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Data/AI products (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run) and big data processing (Spark, Dataproc)
  • Strong familiarity with Telco data structures, network performance metrics and open industry frameworks (e.g., TM Forum Open Digital Architecture)
  • Robust understanding of production MLOps lifecycles (CI/CD) and enterprise orchestration
  • Professional certifications such as Google Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer or equivalent Cloud Architect/AI credentials are highly regarded

 

Soft Skills :

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and team management skills to effectively direct a technical team and collaborate across a matrixed organization
  • Proven ability to lead and drive initiatives independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Exceptional analytical, conceptual, and strategic problem-solving abilities
  • Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical architectures, risks, and AI strategies into clear, actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership

title: Staff-Tech. Planning & Development
raw_description:
Role Purpose

As a Staff-Tech Planning & Development professional within the CX Tech Planning & Project Tracking unit, this role will lead the hands-on development, configuration, and end-to-end delivery of customer experience automation and A.I initiatives. The role combines technical expertise with strong project execution, connecting core platforms such as Siebel CRM, Salesforce Service Cloud, and RPA with customer-facing solutions including A.I Agent Assist, A.I Copilot, Social Media Automation, Voice A.I, Self-Service Portals, Semantic Search, and automated Knowledge Bases.

 

Working closely with IT, Martech, Product, Finance, and Business Process teams, this role will turn customer and business needs into practical, scalable digital solutions. This role will directly improve how frontline agents work and how customers access support by rapidly building, testing, and deploying solutions that increase efficiency, enable self-service, and improve the overall customer experience. 

 

Staff-Tech Planning & Development is responsible to identify, evaluate, and propose new technologies and AI solutions to enhance the customer experience. Conduct research, analyze data, and support the development of innovation proposals, pilots, and Proofs of Concept. Support day-to-day project enablement for technology and digital initiatives, including stakeholder coordination, milestone and dependency tracking, risk and issue escalation, and the transition of validated solutions from POC or pilot into implementation. Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather insights and contribute to digital innovation within the customer experience organization. This role is also responsible to apply responsible-AI and data-protection considerations to technology and AI use cases, in line with UU PDP No. 27/2022 and internal policy.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Background:

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/A.I, Business Administration with a technology focus, or a related field
  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in an analytical role, preferably with exposure to technology research, data analysis, or digital initiative implementation; experience in the telecom industry is a plus. Fresh Graduate with Internship, apprenticeship, or substantial final-project experience in technology or digital initiatives may be counted toward this requirement.
  • Working or internship experience within a digital start-up or fast-paced digital environment is highly preferred

Technical Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (e.g. Python or JavaScript/Node.js), sufficient to query data, automate routine tasks, and prototype simple internal tools with understanding of REST API, JSON, webhooks, system integration, and data flow.
  • Working experience with a cloud CRM platform (e.g. Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or equivalent), including day-to-day configuration or administration support; a practitioner certification such as Salesforce ADM 201 will be a plus.
  • Basic understanding of software development principles and methodologies, with the ability to develop and deploy simple internal applications or scripts to address specific operational challenges or create workarounds
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts, cloud service models (SaaS / PaaS), common integration patterns, and data flows, sufficient to assess vendor solutions and communicate requirements to technical teams
  • Fundamental understanding of AI/ML concepts, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools in a work or academic context (e.g. prompt design, summarization, drafting, first-pass analysis), together with a realistic understanding of their limitations
  • Working familiarity with a data visualization or BI tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio), and with spreadsheet-based estimation of benefits, costs, and ROI
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes.

Project Management Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English, sufficient to document requirements and present findings to both business and technical audiences
  • Understanding of Digital Transformation principles and their application within a customer service organization, including how technology can reshape customer interactions and operational processes
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum fundamentals: backlog management, user stories, sprint planning, stand-ups, UAT, retrospectives, and release management.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Postman, monday.com or equivalent delivery tools.
  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and with digital communication channels relevant to customer service (e.g. mobile apps, messaging platforms, social media)
  • Ability to act as both Project Coordinator and Hands-on Builder, moving from requirement → design → development/configuration → testing → deployment → measurement.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and SOPs into technical user stories while collaborating across IT, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Customer Care operations.
  • Basic understanding of contact center and digital channel technology — IVR, chatbot and voicebot, omnichannel routing, and knowledge management — and of the operational metrics they influence (AHT, FCR, self-service containment, CSAT).
  • Awareness of data privacy and responsible-AI obligations affecting customer data, including UU PDP No. 27/2022, and of why human oversight is required in AI-assisted customer journeys
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and principles (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches), and familiarity with at least one project or work tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Planner)
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes
  • Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.

Secondary Competency

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends
  • Excellent research and information-gathering skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and concisely
  • Passion for emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence (AI), and their application in customer experience
  • Ability to translate operational and customer pain points into process flows, requirements, and acceptance criteria with measurable success indicators
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and to coordinate across business, technology, and operations stakeholders
  • Ability to support change and adoption activities, including communication, training, adoption tracking, and post-implementation stabilization
  • Learning agility and adaptability actively builds new knowledge as technologies and tools change, and adjusts approach when priorities, requirements, or platforms shift
  • Possess self-initiative and able to work independently and collaboratively with people at various levels
  • Good time management and organizational skills arranges tasks in order of priority, manages preparations and schedules, and stays focused to keep on track
  • Comfortable working across business and technology teams and translating business requirements into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask across multiple projects, manage priorities, document progress, and meet delivery timelines.
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with an understanding of Digital Customer Experience and service journey principles.
  • Willingness and ability to continuously self-learn emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, CRM, and digital CX technologies.

  • Familiarity with API integration concepts, cloud service models (SaaS / PaaS), common integration patterns, and data flows, sufficient to assess vendor solutions and communicate requirements to technical teams
  • Fundamental understanding of AI/ML concepts, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools in a work or academic context (e.g. prompt design, summarization, drafting, first-pass analysis), together with a realistic understanding of their limitations
  • Working familiarity with a data visualization or BI tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio), and with spreadsheet-based estimation of benefits, costs, and ROI
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes.

Project Management Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English, sufficient to document requirements and present findings to both business and technical audiences
  • Understanding of Digital Transformation principles and their application within a customer service organization, including how technology can reshape customer interactions and operational processes
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum fundamentals: backlog management, user stories, sprint planning, stand-ups, UAT, retrospectives, and release management.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Postman, monday.com or equivalent delivery tools.
  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and with digital communication channels relevant to customer service (e.g. mobile apps, messaging platforms, social media)
  • Ability to act as both Project Coordinator and Hands-on Builder, moving from requirement → design → development/configuration → testing → deployment → measurement.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and SOPs into technical user stories while collaborating across IT, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Customer Care operations.
  • Basic understanding of contact center and digital channel technology — IVR, chatbot and voicebot, omnichannel routing, and knowledge management — and of the operational metrics they influence (AHT, FCR, self-service containment, CSAT).
  • Awareness of data privacy and responsible-AI obligations affecting customer data, including UU PDP No. 27/2022, and of why human oversight is required in AI-assisted customer journeys
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and principles (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches), and familiarity with at least one project or work tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Planner)
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes
  • Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.

Secondary Competency

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends
  • Excellent research and information-gathering skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and concisely
  • Passion for emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence (AI), and their application in customer experience
  • Ability to translate operational and customer pain points into process flows, requirements, and acceptance criteria with measurable success indicators
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and to coordinate across business, technology, and operations stakeholders
  • Ability to support change and adoption activities, including communication, training, adoption tracking, and post-implementation stabilization
  • Learning agility and adaptability actively builds new knowledge as technologies and tools change, and adjusts approach when priorities, requirements, or platforms shift
  • Possess self-initiative and able to work independently and collaboratively with people at various levels
  • Good time management and organizational skills arranges tasks in order of priority, manages preparations and schedules, and stays focused to keep on track
  • Comfortable working across business and technology teams and translating business requirements into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to multitask across multiple projects, manage priorities, document progress, and meet delivery timelines.
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with an understanding of Digital Customer Experience and service journey principles.
  • Willingness and ability to continuously self-learn emerging technologies, particularly AI, automation, CRM, and digital CX technologies.

title: Sr Officer-Retail Store App Development
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The purpose of the Retail & Store System Integration role is to serve as the strategic architect of the IOH Retail & Store System (Owned Store, Direct Sales, Partner Store) journey including supporting system such as (POSS, Queueing System, Digital Vending Machine, Siebel, Logistic/ERP), ensuring the application is both a commercial powerhouse and a user-friendly tool.

  • Conduct deep-dive assessments of IOH Retail & Store Application Ecosystem (POSS, Queueing Management, Digital Vending Machine) and user feedback to identify friction points within the application, translating complex metrics into actionable development insights.
  • Lead an iterative "test and learn" approach, consistently refining application features to stay ahead of evolving technology and shifting market demands.
  • Prioritize the user experience to ensure the application isn't just functional but also fostering trust and stability from daily use by Agent & Customer.
  • Ensuring all technical implementations are aligned with broader commercial objectives, contributing to the bottom line and maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
  • Orchestrate complex project timelines and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality application enhancements on schedule and within scope.

 

  1. Scope

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Software Development & Delivery Leadership
  • Lead and manage agile development teams delivering retail platform features
  • Oversee the full software development lifecycle (planning, coding, testing, deployment)

Product & Business Alignment
  • Work closely with business users to understand feature requirements and business goals
  • Translate business needs into clear technical solutions and implementation plans
  • Prioritize technical deliverables to balance speed, quality, and value

Platform Modernization & Innovation
  • Drive modernization initiatives such as microservices, API-first design, and cloud-native solutions
  • Explore and incorporate emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, personalization, real-time analytics)
  • Promote continuous improvement through innovation and technical excellence

 

 

Requirements

 

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience working in delivering Retail Store Ecosystem (POSS, Queueing System, Digital Vending Machine) and digital solutions, especially on mobile and web-based applications
  • Deep knowledge of Siebel CRM, Logistic/ERP & eKYC Biometric Verification Technology
  • Deep knowledge of system integration using common communication methods such as SOAP and JSON
  • Knowledge and able to work with Agile Approach
  • Team player on project-based delivery
  • Understanding security principles integrating single page apps, mobile apps, and third-party systems using OAuth2, SSO, JWT.
  • Understanding of Microservices architecture and patterns, micro gateway, docker, Kubernetes fundamental.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills and capabilities
  • Target oriented problem-solving approach and decision-making capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge on navigating the UI/UX requirement using Figma and translates into technical requirements.

 

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years' hands-on experience in solutioning, architecting and delivering mobile app and website products.
  • Product Development, Product management capability, especially on telecommunication industry
  • Preferably had various assignments in different functions in Marketing or having experience in working in highly dynamic companies
  • Deep understanding of the telecommunication and competitive landscape in Indonesia
  • Highly experienced in leading cross functional teams

 

Skills:

  • Agile leaner and responsive to feedback
  • Collaborative team player
  • Ability to plan holistically
  • Quality & Results Orientation

Proactive to ensure goals are met and we stay ahead of the competition

title: AVP-Digital Opex Management
raw_description:
Long Description

About the Role

The AVP Digital Opex Management is responsible for leading operational expenditure (Opex) planning, governance, monitoring, and cost optimization across the Technology organization. This role ensures effective budget utilization, financial discipline, and sustainable operational spending while supporting the organization's digital and technology objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead annual Digital IT Opex and Finance Lease planning aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.
  • Develop and maintain Opex baseline, financial forecasts, and run-rate models.
  • Monitor Opex utilization, identify spending variances, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Establish and strengthen Opex governance, financial controls, and budget compliance.
  • Drive cost optimization initiatives across cloud services, software licenses, maintenance, managed services, and other recurring IT operational costs.
  • Prepare management reports, dashboards, and financial insights to support decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Technology, Finance, Procurement, and Business stakeholders to ensure effective budget execution and governance.

Long Description

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Financial Planning, Budget Management, IT Finance, or Technology Finance.
  • Strong understanding of IT operational expenditure, budgeting, forecasting, and financial governance.
  • Experience working with enterprise financial systems such as SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Anaplan, or equivalent platforms.

Long Description

Professional Expertise

  • IT Opex Planning & Management
  • IT Operational Cost Management
  • Budget Governance & Financial Controls
  • Financial Forecasting & Run-rate Analysis
  • IT Cost Optimization
  • Cloud Cost Management
  • Software License Financial Management
  • Vendor Cost Management
  • Financial Reporting & Dashboarding
  • Enterprise Financial Systems (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Anaplan)

Long Description

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Analytical & Problem Solving
  • Business Acumen
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Communication & Presentation
  • Continuous Improvement

 

Location: Jakarta Head Office

title: Staff-Customer Experience
raw_description:
Job Description: Staff Customer Experience

Division: Market Research

 

Job Summary:

Responsible for executing end-to-end quantitative CX research, advanced data extraction, and AI-assisted analytics to generate actionable insights into customer needs, behaviors, and expectations across IOH’s products and services. The role supports management and cross-functional teams in improving NPS/CSAT, customer retention, and overall customer experience.

 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quantitative Research Design, Execution & Workflow

  • Design and implement quantitative research methodologies based on business needs, including NPS/CSAT tracking, churn prediction studies, and large-scale consumer research.
  • Develop research instruments, including structured questionnaires and measurement frameworks, to ensure reliable and actionable data.
  • Support end-to-end research execution, either internally or in collaboration with external research agencies and vendors, from sample preparation through data collection.
  • Develop and streamline survey and data collection workflows to improve research efficiency, scalability, and turnaround time.

2. Database Querying, Data Analytics & AI-Powered Insight Generation

  • Extract, clean, and manipulate large quantitative datasets directly from cloud databases and data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud Platform / GCP) using structured querying (SQL) to support research needs and baseline tracking.
  • Track, monitor, and analyze key CX performance indicators, including Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), and Customer Effort Score (CES), to identify trends and structural areas for improvement.
  • Conduct unified analytics on structured and unstructured customer feedback using quantitative frameworks across multiple touchpoints (myIM3, bima+, call centers, retail outlets, social media) integrated into automated dashboards.
  • Utilize agentic AI frameworks and LLM-driven research tools to accelerate quantitative data synthesis, automated sentiment classification, pattern recognition, and trend identification.
  • Translate complex quantitative datasets into clear data storytelling and actionable strategic insights for key stakeholders.

3. Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare periodic quantitative research reports (weekly, monthly, and project-based), supported by live CX monitoring dashboards and GCP-backed data pipelines.
  • Present quantitative research findings, analytical insights, and data-driven recommendations to management and product owners in a clear and structured manner.

Qualifications & Requirements

Educational Background & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Work Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Quantitative Market Research, CX Research, Consumer Insights, or Data Analytics. Experience in telecommunications or tech/digital sectors is a strong plus.

Technical & Analytics Skills:

  • Database & Querying: Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform / GCP, BigQuery) and proficiency in writing queries (SQL) for data extraction, joining complex datasets, and processing raw analytics data.
  • CX Frameworks: Strong foundation in quantitative CX metrics and frameworks (NPS, CSAT, CES, quantitative Customer Journey Mapping).
  • Data Analytics & Visualization: Proficiency in data analysis tools and visualization platforms (e.g., Python, R, Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker).
  • Research Automation & Agentic AI: Hands-on experience or working familiarity with AI tools and Agentic AI concepts (e.g., leveraging LLMs, AI research agents, or automated text/sentiment analysis tools for quantitative data synthesis).

Key Competencies & Soft Skills:

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Strong passion for understanding customer perspectives and utilizing empirical data to drive experience improvements.
  • Data-Driven & Quantitative Thinking: Ability to analyze complex numerical data and construct logical, actionable business narratives.
  • Adaptability to Emerging Technology: Proactive in learning and applying cloud technologies, advanced querying techniques, AI frameworks, and automated methodologies.
  • Communication & Presentation: Fluent in English and Indonesian, with an ability to translate complex technical/quantitative findings into clear executive insights.
  • Teamwork & Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional technical (data engineers, IT) and business stakeholders to support strategic research objectives.

  • Utilize agentic AI frameworks and LLM-driven research tools to accelerate quantitative data synthesis, automated sentiment classification, pattern recognition, and trend identification.
  • Translate complex quantitative datasets into clear data storytelling and actionable strategic insights for key stakeholders.

3. Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare periodic quantitative research reports (weekly, monthly, and project-based), supported by live CX monitoring dashboards and GCP-backed data pipelines.
  • Present quantitative research findings, analytical insights, and data-driven recommendations to management and product owners in a clear and structured manner.

Qualifications & Requirements

Educational Background & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Work Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Quantitative Market Research, CX Research, Consumer Insights, or Data Analytics. Experience in telecommunications or tech/digital sectors is a strong plus.

Technical & Analytics Skills:

  • Database & Querying: Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform / GCP, BigQuery) and proficiency in writing queries (SQL) for data extraction, joining complex datasets, and processing raw analytics data.
  • CX Frameworks: Strong foundation in quantitative CX metrics and frameworks (NPS, CSAT, CES, quantitative Customer Journey Mapping).
  • Data Analytics & Visualization: Proficiency in data analysis tools and visualization platforms (e.g., Python, R, Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker).
  • Research Automation & Agentic AI: Hands-on experience or working familiarity with AI tools and Agentic AI concepts (e.g., leveraging LLMs, AI research agents, or automated text/sentiment analysis tools for quantitative data synthesis).

Key Competencies & Soft Skills:

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Strong passion for understanding customer perspectives and utilizing empirical data to drive experience improvements.
  • Data-Driven & Quantitative Thinking: Ability to analyze complex numerical data and construct logical, actionable business narratives.
  • Adaptability to Emerging Technology: Proactive in learning and applying cloud technologies, advanced querying techniques, AI frameworks, and automated methodologies.
  • Communication & Presentation: Fluent in English and Indonesian, with an ability to translate complex technical/quantitative findings into clear executive insights.
  • Teamwork & Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional technical (data engineers, IT) and business stakeholders to support strategic research objectives.

The role ensures the safe, reliable, and cost-effective execution of marine transportation services, including vessel scheduling, cargo movements, and port operations, while ensuring compliance with Company standards, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations. The Marine Supervisor coordinates with offshore and onshore stakeholders to optimize vessel utilization, cargo readiness, and operational efficiency, resolves day-to-day marine operational issues, monitors contractor performance, and drives continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service reliability, operational efficiency, and cost performance.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Manage vessel schedules, deployment, and berth planning to support drilling, project, and operational activities. 
  • Coordinate daily marine logistics, including cargo loading and offloading, personnel transfers, and the delivery of fuel, water, and bulk materials. 
  • Maintain accurate records of vessel movements, daily reports, fuel bunkering, and consumption. 
  • Coordinate and resolve routine marine operational and technical issues, including vessel availability, equipment problems, weather delays, and port constraints. 
  • Monitor contractor compliance with safety requirements and service agreements. 
  • Communicate vessel schedules and operational updates to relevant stakeholders. 
  • Monitor vessel costs and utilization and identify opportunities to improve efficiency. 
  • Verify vessel and crew documentation to ensure compliance with contractual and seaworthiness requirements.
  • Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and follow up on corrective actions. 
  • Recommend schedule changes, voyage consolidation, or vessel off-hire to optimize cost and performance. 
  • Support continuous improvement through performance analysis and contractor engagement. 
  • Oversee daily vessel movements and berth assignments and coordinate with port and shipping agents. 
  • Monitor marine logistics activities supporting offshore and project operations. 
  • Coordinate with offshore and onshore teams to confirm cargo readiness and loading priorities. 
  • Update records for vessel arrivals and departures, fuel usage, cargo weights, and port activities. 
  • Record and report incidents, near misses, weather delays, and operational disruptions. 
  • Inform stakeholders of delays, incidents, and schedule changes. 
  • Monitor contractor performance and compliance with safety and operational requirements. 
  • Track vessel day-rate costs against budget. 
  • Review vessel utilization and identify inefficiencies. 
  • Verify vessel certifications, crew documents, and port clearances. 
  • Coordinate with vessel masters and contractors to resolve operational and technical issues. 
  • Enter logistics data into company systems, including Digital Transport Management (DTM), and ensure timely and accurate reporting.

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Petroleum Engineering Technical Leader

Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Petroleum Engineering Technical Leader


Purpose:

To coordinate and supervise the petroleum engineering team in ensuring the production and completion of optimization through suitable actions and the correct management of recorded production data.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Follow-up of the Drilling and Production Surveillance Activity.
  • Plan well testing acquisition and follow up the execution. 
  • Interface with operated and non-operated reservoir teams suggesting well interventions to optimize the well performance and to assure the correct field implementation and execution.
  • Participate to the preparation of well drilling programs, planning the acquisition of the dynamic data.
  • Contribute to identifying possible actions to ensure maximum efficiency in the optimization of well production ensuring technical quality and cost effectiveness of the solution adopted.
  • Analyse and interpret the well test and production data collected at the well site, to ensure their QC.
  • Contribute to the preparation of documents relevant to the work over and production activity.
  • Propose and introduce new technologies aimed at improving well performances, field recovery and economics.
  • Identify the formation damage problems.
  • Provide the necessary support to operated and non-operated reservoir teams related to Production Optimization programs including main stimulation techniques (fracturing and acid stimulation), well performance analysis, well test design and interpretation, reservoir drive mechanism analysis.
  • Monitor production activities and analyse production data, verify compliance with forecasts and propose the necessary actions to ensure a cost-effective reservoir management

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.

    • Experienced in team leading and/or managing professional personnels.
  • Training & Certification: 
    • Petroleum & Reservoir Engineering
    • Subsurface
    • Assets Management
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

Quality Management System

  • Maintain governance over controlled documents, records, action tracking, management reviews, audit programs and improvement initiatives. 


Emergency Response and Preparedness 

  • Lead the governance and continual improvement of emergency preparedness and response arrangements for credible scenarios affecting offices, logistics, projects, onshore and offshore operations. 
  • Coordinate risk-based emergency scenario identification and maintain tiered emergency response plans, crisis-management interfaces, notification and escalation protocols, call-out lists, duty arrangements and mutual-aid or external support interfaces. 
  • Ensure response plans address, as applicable, fire and explosion, hydrocarbon or chemical release, medical emergency and medevac, marine or aviation incident, loss of containment, environmental spill, security threat, severe weather, natural hazard, evacuation, search and rescue, and business disruption. 
  • Define emergency organization roles, command-and-control arrangements, decision authorities, communication protocols, accountability systems, emergency facilities and minimum equipment requirements. 
  • Plan and evaluate drills and exercises through a risk-based multi-year program, including notification tests, table-top exercises, functional drills and full-scale exercises involving contractors and external agencies where relevant. 
  • Develop exercise objectives and injects, assign evaluators, document observations and lessons, track corrective actions to closure and verify improvement through repeat testing. 
  • Assure readiness of emergency control rooms, communication systems, response equipment, spill-response resources, first-aid and medical arrangements, evacuation systems and emergency documentation through scheduled inspections and tests. 
  • Coordinate competency requirements, training and refresher programs for emergency response team members, incident management teams, wardens, first aiders and other designated roles. 
  • Maintain effective interfaces with regulators, local authorities, hospitals, emergency services, mutual-aid partners, specialist response providers, contractors and community stakeholders, as applicable. 
  • After an actual event, support response debriefing, investigation, welfare follow-up, recovery planning, regulatory reporting and incorporation of lessons learned into plans, training and controls. 



Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.

  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Loading Master
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


Purpose:

The Loading Master is a senior marine officer responsible for the safe and efficient management of all hydrocarbon cargo and ballast water systems onboard the FPSO. This includes ensuring vessel stability and trim, maintaining cargo quality specifications, and preparing for offloading operations. The role requires deep coordination with the Topside Operations team to balance production with storage capacity and acts as the lead for the cargo and ballast control operators. Strict adherence to Indonesian national regulations is mandatory.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

A. Cargo & Ballast Management:

  • Cargo Planning: Develop and execute detailed cargo and ballast management plans to maintain the FPSO's stability, hull stress, upright heel/list and draught within designed limits at all times. Develop plan and execute work sequence during cargo offload to offtake tanker.
  • System Operation: Manage and oversee the operation of the cargo and ballast systems, including pumps, valves, inert system, crude oil washing system and stripping systems, via the ship's automated control system.
  • Storage Management: Monitor tank levels, temperatures, and pressures for all cargo tanks, slop tanks, and all other tanks including ballast tanks. Coordinate with Production to manage incoming production flow against available storage capacity.

Stability & Stress Calculations: Perform daily and critical-operation stability, trim, and shear force/bending moment calculations using dedicated software. Issue formal reports.

B. Cargo Quality Assurance:

  • Quality Control: Work closely with the Production Chemist or Topside Operators to monitor the quality of produced condensate/oil (e.g., BS&W, salinity, density, RVP).
  • Specification Compliance: Ensure all cargo in storage meets the contractual specifications required for offtake and sale. This involves overseeing the sampling and testing process.
  • Tank Cleaning: Plan and oversee tank cleaning operations to maintain cargo quality and prevent contamination.
  • Cargo Records: Maintain accurate records of all cargo quantities (including ullage/innage gauging) and quality data for reconciliation and customs purposes.

C. Offloading Preparation & Support:

  • Pre-Offloading Readiness: Prepare the cargo system for offloading: line up valves, prepare pumps, and ensure all equipment is functional. Prepare all administration documents include but are not limited to Pre Arrival Check, Cargo Meeting, Sequence Time during Cargo Operation.
  • Support to Mooring Master: Work under the direction of the Mooring Master (a distinct, often more senior role) during the offloading process. The Loading Master's team manages the internal cargo transfer and pumping to the offtake tanker.
  • Cargo Calculation: Accurately calculate and document the quantity of cargo transferred to the shuttle tanker (Bill of Lading figures, Manifest, Statement of Fact), acting as the FPSO's official representative for quantity.

D. Team Management & Safety:

  • Supervision: Directly supervise the Cargo Control Room Operators, Ballast Operator and deck crew involved in cargo and ballast operations.
  • Training: Ensure all team members are trained and competent in operating cargo/ballast systems and emergency procedures.
  • Safety & Compliance: Enforce all safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems, and isolations for work on cargo and ballast systems. Lead by example in implementing the company's Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Emergency Response: Fulfill a key role in the vessel's Emergency Response team, particularly for scenarios related to cargo spills, stability issues, or fire/explosion.

E. Coordination & Administration (Indonesia Focus):

  • Interface with Topside Operations: Maintain constant communication with the Production team lead to align marine storage plans with production rates and shutdowns. This is a critical daily interface.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations comply with Indonesian regulations from:
    • DIRJEN HUBLA (Directorate General of Sea Transportation): Cargo Operations, Vessel stability, safety, and pollution prevention regulations.
    • SKK Migas: Specific reporting and operational requirements for oil and gas upstream activities.
    • Customs & Excise: Accurate reporting of cargo quantities for export and tax purposes.
  • Documentation: Manage all marine-related documentation, including cargo logs, ballast water record books, stability booklets, Intact Stability Booklet and Indonesian regulatory reports.

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·        Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

·        Report all incidents

·        Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards

Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

·        Education: Minimum Level Class -2 Deck Officer with dangerous cargo endorsement.

·        Professional Qualification:

-      A minimum of 5 years of experience as a Chief Officer (C/O) on crude oil tankers, product tankers, or LNG carriers. Direct experience on an FPSO or FSO is highly desirable and often essential.

-      Proven, hands-on experience in cargo and ballast operations, including extensive use of automated control systems.

-      Demonstrated experience in performing stability and stress calculations for large vessels.

-      Experience in a supervisory role, managing a team of operators.

-      Experience working in Southeast Asia or Indonesia is a significant advantage.

Certification, training and courses:

Mandatory Certifications (STCW & Indonesian):

•     Chief Mate (Class II) or Master Mariner (Class I) Certificate of Competency recognized by the Indonesian government. A Chief Mate ticket is often the minimum requirement.

•     Valid STCW Certificates (Advanced Firefighting, Proficiency in Survival Craft, etc.).

•     Tanker Endorsements: Mandatory STCW certificates for Oil Tanker and preferably Liquefied Gas Tanker operations (for condensate).

•     Seafarer's Medical Certificate.

•     Indonesian Specific Certifications: The company will facilitate, but eligibility is key. This may include:

•    ADPT (Ahli Deklarasi Pengangkutan Tujuan) for hazardous cargo.

•    Familiarization with Indonesian port state and flag state requirements.

Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa

 

Required Competencies:

Technical Competencies

  • Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of tanker operations, hydrodynamics, and crude oil/condensate characteristics.

Non-Technical Competencies

  • Leadership & Teamwork: Ability to lead a marine team and collaborate effectively with the production (topside) department, which often has a different reporting structure and priorities.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot issues with cargo systems, balance stability during production, and manage capacity constraints.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Bahasa Indonesia is a major advantage for managing local crew and understanding local regulations.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Absolute accuracy is required in cargo calculations, stability calculations, and following complex procedures.

 

Working Conditions:

Offshore/FPSO, possibility for business travel to other Eni premises or field areas.

title: Medco E & P Indonesia - Site Project Cost Controller (TPC)
raw_description:
Medco E & P Indonesia is looking for an experienced Site Project Cost Controller to join our team through a Third-Party Contract (TPC). In this role, you will contribute to Sakakemang PSC, an upstream oil and gas project located in South Sumatra and operated by MedcoEnergi. Currently in the development phase, the project is progressing toward First Gas/First Production, with start-up targeted for Q3 2027.



In this role, you will lead project cost control, forecasting, change and contingency management, contractor cost performance, stakeholder coordination, and audit close-out activities, ensuring accurate cost reporting, effective risk management, governance compliance, and integrated decision support throughout the project lifecycle.



Key Responsibilities



Cost Leadership & Governance

  • Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of the project cost control framework, including CAPEX and OPEX management.
  • Establish and manage the cost baseline, cost breakdown structure (CBS), and alignment with project WBS.
  • Ensure cost control activities comply with company standards, project governance, and assurance requirements.



Cost Monitoring, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Provide senior oversight on cost performance monitoring, including commitments, actuals, accruals, and forecasts.
  • Prepare and review monthly and ad-hoc cost reports, cash flow forecasts, and variance analyses for project management, partners, and governance forums.
  • Lead the development of Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Estimate to Complete (ETC), ensuring accuracy and timely escalation of cost risks.



Change, Risk & Contingency Management

  • Lead cost evaluation of scope changes, variations, claims, and management of change (MOC) processes.
  • Manage and control project contingencies, ensuring disciplined drawdown aligned with risk assessments.
  • Integrate cost risk and opportunity analysis into overall project risk management and decision-making.



Contract, Procurement & Contractor Cost Control

  • Provide senior cost input to procurement strategies, bid evaluations, contract awards, and commercial negotiations.
  • Oversee contractor progress measurement, invoicing, claims assessment, and payment verification.
  • Ensure consistent cost performance tracking across EPC/EPCM contractors and major vendors.



Integration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with Senior Project Engineers, Planning & Scheduling, Finance, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning teams to ensure fully integrated project controls.
  • Act as a key interface for cost matters with JV partners, auditors, and management assurance teams.
  • Provide clear and credible cost advice to support project leadership decision-making.



Assurance, Audit & Close-Out

  • Support internal and external audits, assurance reviews, and stage gate approvals by providing transparent and traceable cost data.
  • Lead cost-related close-out activities, including AFE close-out, final account reconciliation, and financial handover to Finance.
  • Capture cost lessons learned to support continuous improvement and future project benchmarking.
raw_requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 of experience in project cost control, with strong exposure to Oil and Gas project.
  • Demonstrated experience in cost control roles within major Oil and Gas company or EPC/EPCM project environments.
  • Strong knowledge of cost estimating, forecasting, commercial management, and project assurance frameworks.
  • English B2 (Upper Intermediate) Level.


Disclaimer: The selected candidate will be engaged on a contract basis through a third-party company appointed by MedcoEnergi. This role supports MedcoEnergi's projects and business objectives, and is delivered in alignment with the Company's standards, governance, and operational requirements.

Own, lead and drive the eCommerce business of SawitPRO called Toko Sawit

To drive the online demand for goods and services sold by SawitPRO

best price guarantee

of SawitPRO

title: Head of Smallholder Relationship (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Smallholder Relationship (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

About The Job:

As a Head of Smallholder Management in SawitPRO, you will play a pivotal role in managing a team with focus building and maintaining positive relationships with palm oil smallholders, enabling us to deliver meaningful support and resources to enhance their agricultural practices and economic opportunities. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of smallholder farming communities, excellent communication skills, and a strong commitment to social impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead, coach, and mentor a team of smallholder management professionals, providing guidance, support, and feedback to help them achieve their goals.

Set clear performance targets for the smallholder management team, monitor performance against targets, and take corrective action as needed.

Develop and manage the budget, forecasting revenue and expenses to ensure financial targets are met.

Build and maintain strong relationships with smallholders, especially with our users, by providing support, guidance, and assistance to address their needs and challenges.

Provide smallholder support programs, monitor and evaluate effectiveness, collect feedback and make recommendations, on topics such as sustainable agricultural practices, financial literacy, and market access.

Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and market developments to identify new business opportunities to enhance smallholder livelihoods.

Convert leads into paying users, prepare and present solution proposals, quotes, and contracts, negotiating terms and closing deals.

Collaborate with internal teams, including demand (leads) generation / marketing, customer support, and product development, to ensure customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth.

Keep accurate records of smallholder support programs, interactions with smallholders, pipeline opportunities, and outcomes using CRM software.

Kualifikasi

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Rural Development, Business Administration, Marketing, or any related field.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, especially with smallholders in rural areas. Proficiency in local languages spoken in rural areas is highly desirable.

Excellent negotiation and closing skills, with a focus on achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a drive to succeed in a fast-paced, competitive environment.

Previous experience of at least 3 years working with smallholder or rural communities to provide solutions for them. Palm oil smallholders are preferred.Previous experience of at least 3 years leading a high-performance team.

Deep understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing smallholder farmers, particularly in the areas of agriculture, livelihoods, and rural development.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend, Product (Medan)
location: Medan, Medan City, North Sumatra, Indonesia
raw_description:
< Kembali

Senior Software Engineer - Backend, Product (Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Medan, Medan City, North Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Participate in the complete backend services development life cycle.

Develop backend services according to API specifications.

Integrate external / third party services.

Perform system analysis, design, testing, and documentation whenever necessary.

Write testing for unit and system integration.

Maintain code quality, unit testing, and automation

Provide technical support on on-call rotations.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's Degree, or Master's Degree, in Computer Science / IT, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), or equivalent.

Proficiency in Golang as primary language and other languages such as Java.

Proficiency in Git

Proficiency in PostgreSQL

At least 4 years working experience in backend services using Golang and Postgres database.

Knowledge of RESTful APIs and microservices, experience designing & consuming them

Experience in designing OpenAPI-based API.

Experience in working in cross-functional teams.

Have discipline in writing unit tests and integration tests.

Familiarity with development on cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS.

Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous deployment.

Familiarity with the Scrum development process.

Ready to be placed in Medan or willing to relocate there.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

title: Software Engineer – Backend, Delivery Team (Pekanbaru)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Software Engineer – Backend, Delivery Team (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

You will join the KebunPRO Delivery Engineering team, responsible for configuring, integrating, and migrating customer environments during the onboarding of large estate-owner accounts, working alongside the Delivery Manager, Field Customer Support Engineers, and Product Engineering.

You will be responsible for:

Configuring and setting up backend environments and services for new KebunPRO customer accounts during the delivery lifecycle.

Designing, building, and executing data migration pipelines to move estate, plantation, and workforce data from customer legacy systems into KebunPRO.

Developing and maintaining backend integrations between KebunPRO and third-party or customer systems (e.g. ERP, HR, IoT/sensor data sources).

Participating in kickoff and discovery sessions to translate customer requirements into technical configuration and integration plans.

Supporting go-live and hypercare stages by resolving backend defects and data issues quickly to keep implementation timelines on track.

Writing and maintaining API specifications and technical documentation for each customer delivery.

Performing unit and integration testing for delivery-specific configurations and integrations.

Collaborating with Product Engineering to escalate and resolve product-level gaps discovered during delivery.

Providing technical support on on-call rotations for customers in active delivery or hypercare.

Kualifikasi

Possess at least an Advanced Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, or Master's Degree in Computer Science / IT, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication), or equivalent.

At least 2 years of working experience in backend software development.

Good knowledge of and familiarity with Golang; experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases.

Experience with data migration, ETL processes, or system integration work is a strong plus.

Experience working with Source Control (Git).

Experience working with Webservices integration (REST and SOAP) and API responses (JSON and XML). Experience with OpenAPI 3.0 is a plus.

Good discipline in writing unit tests and integration tests.

Experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS is a plus.

Proficiency with AI-augmented software engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, or Antigravity to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.

Good interpersonal skills, a team player, and able to work independently and directly with customers during time-boxed delivery engagements.

Must be analytical, a problem-solver, and comfortable operating under delivery deadlines.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

Plantation Delivery Executive/Coordinator

, Anda bertanggung jawab atas keberhasilan implementasi dan eksekusi solusi teknologi/layanan SawitPRO (seperti sistem digitalisasi perkebunan

Kebun Pro

dan layanan operasional terkait) pada perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra di wilayah Pekanbaru dan sekitarnya. Anda akan menjadi penghubung utama antara tim internal SawitPRO dengan klien perkebunan untuk memastikan proyek berjalan sesuai jadwal, cakupan, dan standar kualitas terbaik.

Tanggung Jawab Utama (Job Description)

Manajemen & Eksekusi Proyek:

Memimpin end-to-end implementasi solusi/produk SawitPRO di area perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra.

Menyusun rencana proyek, alokasi sumber daya, timeline, serta mengelola risiko teknis maupun operasional di lapangan.

Manajemen Hubungan Pelanggan (Client Management):

Menjadi titik kontak utama (

single point of contact

) bagi manajemen perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra di area Riau/Pekanbaru.

Memahami kebutuhan operasional klien serta memastikan adopsi sistem/produk berjalan secara lancar.

Adopsi & Pelatihan Lapangan:

Mengoordinasikan dan memfasilitasi sesi pelatihan untuk pengelola perkebunan, staf operasional, dan pekerja lapangan agar dapat mengoperasikan sistem dengan efektif.

Memantau tingkat penggunaan (

usage rate

) produk dan memberikan panduan atau solusi berkelanjutan bagi klien.

Koordinasi Lintas Fungsi:

Bekerja sama erat dengan tim Product, Engineering, Sales, dan Operations internal untuk menyampaikan

feedback

dari lapangan dan penyelesaian masalah teknis secara cepat.

Melakukan pelaporan berkala terkait status proyek dan kesehatan akun (

account health

) kepada pimpinan.

Kualifikasi

Kualifikasi & Persyaratan (Requirements)

Pendidikan:

Minimal S1 di bidang Perkebunan/Pertanian, Sistem Informasi, Teknik, atau jurusan terkait.

Sertifikasi manajemen proyek (seperti PMP) menjadi nilai tambah.

Pengalaman Kerja:

Pengalaman minimal 5+ tahun dalam implementasi proyek (

project implementation

), operasional perkebunan kelapa sawit, atau penyebaran perangkat lunak enterprise (

enterprise software deployment

).

Memiliki pengalaman langsung bekerja/berinteraksi dengan perkebunan kelapa sawit.

Terbiasa mengoordinasikan tim lintas fungsi (

cross-functional teams

) dan mengelola beberapa proyek bersamaan.

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team - we work on a diverse set of consumer problems spanning across core experiences that power the UX navigation and transaction funnels, search and discovery of content and services, user lifecycle covering user growth, engagement and loyalty and the critical platform mission of mobile application developer experience. We are on an exciting mission to connect consumers to Grab's marketplace by allowing them to discover and engage with Grab's services and partners.

Get to Know the Role

You are a Senior Engineer who designs, builds, operates, and monitors secure, high-quality software systems. You will partner with technical and non-technical team members from product design through rollout, drive project momentum, and uplift the team through mentorship and process improvements.

You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager, and you will be based on-site in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Design and write in RxJava and/or Kotlin.

Collaborate with mobile and backend engineers, designers, data scientists and product managers to build features

Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards

Brainstorm ideas, identify problems, propose and implement solutions geared towards scale and performance

Take full ownership of projects that are built to meet functional and non-functional requirements of our users and partners.

Design, implement, instrument and deploy highly performant and reusable Android components for operational excellence programs

Lead collaboration across teams and roles, to resolve ambiguous, multi dimensional business, legal, and product needs.

Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent

Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

raw_description:
Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Insurance

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

At Financial Services, we empower the people of Southeast Asia, from consumers and drivers to every-day entrepreneurs, by ensuring financial inclusion for the underserved. The team is building solutions by enabling our partners (i.e. drivers and merchants) to get access to financial services (lending and insurance) products for their everyday needs.

Get to Know the Role

You will report to the Engineering Manager, Insurance, based in Indonesia and will develop the complex backend systems powering the many end-to-end user journeys across all Insurance products available in multiple Grab apps. We're looking for candidates that embody ownership, display a hunger for learning and improvement, excel in autonomy, and have the desire to go above and beyond expectations.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will develop high-quality and scalable backend applications

You will write clean, efficient, and maintainable code to solve challenging problems in the InsurTech domain

You will collaborate with diverse teams to design, and ship new features

You will participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge

Your comprehensive understanding to troubleshoot, debug complex issues, and provide quick resolutions

You will contribute to the architectural decisions and technical direction of the projects

You will participate in On-Call rotations to ensure the reliability of services

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

Years of relevant experience in software development, with proficiency in one of the major programming languages, e.g., Golang (preferred) and Java, relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle and code versioning systems like Git

Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures, and capability to recognise when to use them

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, e.g., AWS
