title: Business Excellence Manager, Food
raw_description:
Business Excellence Manager, Food

Team

Operations

/

Business Strategy

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The ID Food Delivery Team acts as the strategic and operating orchestrator for GrabFood Indonesia. Our main focus is on developing executable business strategies that align with our growth mission and connect multiple teams together to translate business priorities into coordinated execution.

Get to Know the Role

As the Business Excellence Manager, Food, you will help the Head of Food Deliveries shape priorities and drive execution excellence across the GrabFood Indonesia vertical.

You will drive vertical performance management, including financial planning and forecasting, commercial target-setting, and monthly business reviews. This will require you to orchestrate cross-functional coordination across demand, marketplace, and territories— to ensure smooth performance tracking.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across different business domains, turning ambiguous problems into structured decisions, and ensuring strategic initiatives deliver measurable outcomes. You will be based onsite in Grab's Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Lead GrabFood Indonesia's annual, quarterly, and monthly business planning cycles, including financial planning and forecasting as well as commercial target-setting.

Monitor business performance across financial, commercial, marketplace, delivery, user, and merchant metrics, and drive follow-up actions on material gaps.

Structure complex business problems, conduct root-cause analysis, and develop clear recommendations with quantified trade-offs.

Build and improve dashboards, operating cadences, and management updates that enable accurate and timely decision-making.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

5+ years of experience in strategy, business analysis, and/or financial planning and forecasting. Experience in the technology industry is a plus.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration/Business Management, Industrial Engineering

title: Sr. Officer-Account Executive
raw_description:
Role Summary

The Account Director is responsible for strategic client management, ensuring long-term client satisfaction, revenue growth, and acting as the main liaison between clients and internal teams.

Find and pitch complex opportunities from existing or Greenfields Account. Orchestrating with internal and external stakeholder for Core, ICT and IoT and Techco project

 

The role consists of: nurturing and fastening large enterprise account to use Indosat B2B products & services, a “close win”. All team members approach with effective and efficient manner, increase the exposure of Indosat B2B products & services in the marketplace and customer centric focus to maintain loyalty.

Responsibilities:

Sales Execution

  • Plan and execute corporate sales activities for Indosat Business services.
  • Evaluate and create program to improve customer productivity in term of services usage.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise Sales Solution, Marketing, Product Development, Technical and other supporting functions concerning proposal preparation of offering solution and pricing that needed by customer.
  • Coordinate with Major Events to retain customer and increase customer loyalty.
  • Evaluate achievement of target production and revenue from Customer in Bank and Financial Segment

Account Management

  • Prospecting customer and regularly update customer with Indosat B2B products and services
  • Manage sales plan with sales team
  • Validate & update customer credit rating
  • Manage sales team activities
  • Manage all sales team pipeline & sales forecast
  • Cross/Up Selling
  • Manage Bid
  • Develop Sales Project Proposals
  • Manage sales workforce
  • Manage sales performance

Customer Management & Market Analysis

  • Conduct reporting of the sales activities and performance
  • Perform account monitoring and maintenance, Give feedback to Marketing, Product Development and Technical functions concerning trend of service need, market pricing and customer potential.

Sales & Campaign Management

  • Issue and Distribute Marketing Collaterals
  • Manage and track leads

Lead, initiate, and accomplish strategic project with strategic customers.

  • Initiate new project, conducting and lead the action involving marketing, presales, provisioning after-sales team.

Team collaboration

  • Execute and achieve functional goals given by Head of Division (Superior)
  • Work co-operatively with other team members to accomplished delegated tasks assigned by managers
  • Provide support, when appropriate, for the team in cases of absence or unavailability
  • Provide continuous inputs on business process and systems improvement

 

Minimum Requirement

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in any major
  • 7+ years of B2B Tech sales experience with experience in selling ICT, Telco products to Government Accounts.
  • Previous experience as a sales executive, sales manager, account manager for multi segment, or presales/sales consultant/project management. Preferably coming from SI company have an engineering knowledge
  • Proven knowledge and experience in Techo solution
  • Proven ability in monitor and evaluate the performance, make recommendations and also ability to give right direction and use initiative and judgment
  • Having knowledge about the B2B business model and sales methodology
  • Good Networking and Engagement with Top Level in Financial Segment
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets
  • Experience managing mid-to-large accounts independently
  • Strong capability in end-to-end sales cycle
  • Solid negotiation and client management skills
  • Experience handling strategic or high-value accounts
  • Strong consultative selling and solution positioning capability
  • Ability to manage complex stakeholder environments
  • Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and report writing skills
  • Good analytical thinking
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain a strong sales pipeline
  • Flexible and adaptable in under pressure situations and meet short- and long-term deadlines
  • Able to use Microsoft office (excel, ppt, doc, etc)

title: VP-Head of HBB & B2B Planning
raw_description:
Long Description

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of FTTH and FWA technologies and network architecture principles.
  • Strong understanding of B2B business and solution
  • Professional certification in Network Engineering
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for telecommunications.

 

Experience:

  • Has extensive experience at least 5 years of experience in telecommunications network planning and engineering, multiple business unit background of working experiences in HBB & B2B would be an advantage
  • Experience in capacity planning and performance optimization transport for broadband networks.
  • Hands-on experience with cost estimation and budgeting for large-scale network projects.
  • Familiarity with emerging home broadband technologies and industry trends.

 

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to design efficient network solutions.
  • Has excellent reporting, presentation and persuasion skill capabilities.
  • Has excellent knowledge of telecommunication business & process in general.
  • Has broad knowledge of technology roadmap especially in HBB and B2B requirements.
  • Has excellent knowledge in translating business requirement into technical or functional specification.
  • Has strategic thinking of end-to-end demand lifecycle process (requirement, solution and delivery), budget, governance and resources.
  • Has strong business and financial acumen with a sense of shareholder responsibility

 

 

Long Description

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Strategic Planning
  1. Establish divisional KPI based on organizational scorecard and cascaded down the teams for HBB & B2B Planning task
  2. Manage division budget based on work-plan and control the utilization/realization of it

 

  • In order to ensure division operates on budget and help contribute to organizational goals

HBB & B2B Network Planning and Solutions
  1. Capture HBB & B2B business requirements and align with stake holder internally IOH and CKH/OG counterparts, ensuring that the local requirements of IOH are taken into account and the right solutions aligned with B2B business objective in 1 -5 years roadmap.
  2. Align with HBB & B2B and all stake holder including subsidiaries to have synergy and  best solutions and ensure the solution is feasible, implemented and operational running smoothly and competitive in the market. Target FMC (fixed Mobile Convergence) to lock the customer always stay with IOH is the ultimate target
  3. Setup right design principle on HBB, SLA and KPI to drive the partner to deliver for best network in class with the contiguous improvement plan

 

Team Management
  1. Develop and mentor team member(s) to achieve divisional objectives
  2. Monitor and evaluate the performance of staff, make recommendations to supervisor and implement actions, such as promotions and dismissals
  3. Provide feedback to SVP to work with HR team to create the succession plan for the function/ organization and attract, motivate and retain top talent to ensure alignment with the plan

 

In order to ensure talents are attracted, retained developed to meet organizational needs

External Relation
  1. Serve as a company representative for external related functions
  2. To manage the partnership with HBB & B2B 3rd party to have the right operartion model and design principle

 

In order to build good network in the industry and keep the performance and CX in the best quality

title: HBB Fault Management & Service Assurance
raw_description:
Job Description

- Ensure HBB end-to-end network elements incident (infrastructure) & Quality Performance, network configuration & integration management and services, monitoring, tracking and problem management are handled excellently according to network KPI, agreed SLA, and standard methodology, for 24 hours/day, 7 days/week and to avoid any service degradation and company revenue loss.

-           Ensure service problem tracking and monitoring of any network disruption as impact of project activities.

-           Responsible to define, develop & review to continuously improving in the fault management, operation of HBB network to manage network service within a defined SLA.

-           Manage related MS vendors team in day-to-day Fault Management Operation;

-           Consolidate to other functions for issues which are related to HBB network operation and service quality

 

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities
  1. Network Fault Monitoring & Management
  • Build the guidance in monitoring fault management with HBB Network Manage Service in order to solve the repeated problem issue, massive problem issue and to take preventive action/plan for identified (potential) problem.
  • Set up the strategy approach and prioritized program with HBB Network Manage Service to improve the performance service align with defined KPI/KQI.
  • Build the guidance with HBB Network Manage Service team in order to identify, localize and point out the right domain of root cause for every degraded service happened.  
  •  
  •  
  1. Network & Services Problem Tracking
  • With HBB Network Manage Service, build and control the Network & services problem tracking system effectively.
  • Manage the Network & services problem tracking as single point of contact for problem status information.
  • Lead in evaluating and improving the performance of service problem tracking system.
  1. External Relation
  • Serve as a company representative for external related functions

 

In order to build good network in the industry and keep up to date with new trends
  1. On time and accurate reporting

Managing HBB Network Manage Service:

  • Ensure on time Daily, Weekly and Monthly HBB Network Report.
  • Ensure on time Weekly SLA Achievement, Weekly HBB KPI achievement

 

Requirement

 

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of FTTH and FWA technologies and network architecture principles.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for telecommunications.

 

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of experience in telecommunications network planning and engineering.
  • Proven track record in designing and deploying FTTH and FWA networks.
  • Familiarity with emerging home broadband technologies and industry trends.

 

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills for fault management.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills for documentation and reporting.

Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies and business needs

Job Responsibilities

Operational Excellence
Operational Issue Resolution
Operational Management and Performance Monitoring
Operational Performance Monitoring
Operational Support and Coordination

title: VP-Head of Financial Non Bank
raw_description:
Role Purpose

VP-Head of Sales is responsible for leading multiple sales teams through Sales Managers to drive segment-level revenue growth, strategic account expansion, and long-term customer value.
This role focuses on defining and executing sales strategies across a portfolio of accounts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market opportunities. VP-Head of Sales provides direction and oversight to AVP-Head of Sales or any Account Directors, ensuring consistent execution of account plans, pipeline development, and performance management across teams.
In addition, the role requires strong engagement with senior customer stakeholders, guidance on complex sales opportunities, and oversight of forecasting and business performance. VP-Head of Sales acts as a key link between senior leadership and the sales organization, ensuring strategies are effectively translated into execution and delivering sustainable business growth.

Job Details

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop end-to-end IT solutions for B2B Financial Non Bank clients.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Identify technological enhancements to drive operational efficiency and customer value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and strategic direction.
  • Conduct client meetings to gather requirements and present solution options.
  • Provide technical support in client presentations and negotiations.
  • Define project scope, objectives, technical requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • Align internal teams and resources based on project milestones.
  • Monitor and report project progress against targets.
  • Stay current with trends and emerging technologies in supply chain, energy, and digital transformation.
  • Proactively recommend innovations and technology applications.
  • Drive digital enablement across B2B client solutions.
  • Coordinate across IT, product, and operations teams to ensure solution delivery.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams during solution development and implementation.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to solution architects and analysts.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or relevant field is preferred.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of professional experience in IT solution development, enterprise systems, digital infrastructure, ICT, cloud computing, ERP
  • At least 5-7 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, cross-functional projects
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing technology-driven solutions for B2B clients in the Financial Non Bank sector
  • Strong background in working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen in B2B technology environments.
  • Strong project management and budgeting skills.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, cost-effective technical solutions.
  • Leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional team collaboration abilities.
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, client-driven environments.
  • Proven track record in driving segment/portfolio-level revenue growth
  • Strong experience in strategic account management and large-scale deals
  • Experience leading large sales organizations or multi-region coverage

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Flow Assurance Engineer
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Flow Assurance Engineer


Purpose:

  • To provide specialistic engineering input to the project activities starting from the screening studies up to the completion of the execution phase, as direct performer and/or as monitoring/follow-up of the activities performed by others (i.e.  contractors), and direct execution of Flow Assurance studies/analyses. 
  • To ensure follow-up of Development Projects at the FEED stage, performed externally, with quality verification of the results delivered in preliminary and final form. 
  • To provide definition of the Scope of Work documents for external activities. 
  • To review and approve the specification, design and supply, ensuring that it meets project objectives, industry standards and best practice for safety, reliability and cost. 
  • To support Troubleshooting activities through the analysis of field data and provide operational recommendations, both from HQ and on site. 
  • To provide specialistic support to the technical Authority in projects review to ensure technical integrity, to commissioning and start-up, and to production in trouble shooting activities on facilities already in operation. 

 

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Technical integrity of Flow Assurance design.
  • Overall effectiveness and efficiency of Flow Assurance design.
  • Capturing and dissemination of Flow Assurance engineering knowledge.

 

Key activities:

  • Selection of the best technical/ economical solutions for a production facility.
  • Flow Assurance of overall design integrity and compliance with international standards, company guidelines, and engineering best practices
  • Direct and supervise Engineering Detail Contractors during the design, procurement, and construction activities, ensuring the quality of the works according to the contract requirements.
  • Providing technical input, in line with project requirements, into technical studies and Basis of Design for onshore and offshore production and processing facilities.
  • Ensure a smooth and effective transfer of data and information between Contractors and between Contractors and the Company.
  • Identify and create/adopt appropriate Flow Assurance engineering standards, with due consideration of the environmental and logistic conditions of the equipment.
  • Define Flow Assurance requirements.
  • Provide guidance & supervision to the 3D Model Review and related follow-on activities.
  • Optimize installation and construction activities/ sequences, minimize cost and safety risks.
  • Participation in process safety review activities.
  • Act as a technical authority on Flow Assurance issues for operational support.
  • Participation in technical integrity activities and reviews/ audits.
  • Train/ mentor junior engineers.
  • Coordinate with Subsurface engineers regarding completion, well testing and workover interventions; Production and Reservoir engineers; and Production Chemistry specialists in chemical analysis, monitoring and evaluation.


 Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent subjects.
  • Experience: 
    • Minimum of 3 years of working experience in offshore and onshore Oil & Gas projects 
    • Have design experience concerning platform topside units / FPSO’s / subsea manifolds / flexible umbilicals / flowlines and flow assurance studies on subsea pipelines including deep water. 
    • Previous experience as a supervisor of engineering design contractors for offshore facilities / pipelines.
    • Preferably, participation in offshore/onshore operations, either for problem solving or for commissioning / start-up.
  • Training & Certification:
    • Asset Integrity Management System 
    • Oil & Gas Surface Production facilities course
    • Project Engineering Overview in Oil & Gas Industry 
    • Introduction to Construction Management 
    • HSE Management in upstream operations 
    • Petroleum Engineering 
    • Production Optimization Technologies 
    • Hazard Identification course 
    • Hydrocarbon Lifecycle Production Chemistry and Flow Assurance 
    • Energy Efficiency  
    • “e-fast” Web Site for Flow Assurance Study
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

  • Flow Assurance
  • Process Engineering
  • Pipeline Engineering
  • Umbilicals, Risers, and Flowlines (URF)
  • Subsea Systems Design
  • Instrumentation & Telecommunication Systems Design
  • Plant Design
  • HSE Principles and Systems
  • Production Operations
  • Reservoir Management & Evaluation
  • Drilling & Well Completion Activities

Non-Technical Competencies:

  • Problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve control system issues during daily work activities.
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Highly motivated to work under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Eager to learn and self-study for continuous improvement

Working Conditions:

  • Jakarta, Indonesia
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Subsea System Engineer (South Hub)


Purpose:

  • To support facility engineering and project team for subsea field development or intervention works from conceptual, detailed design, execution and installation phases.
  • To ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient design, operation, and integrity of subsea production systems, including subsea trees, manifolds, jumpers, flowlines, umbilicals, and subsea control systems, from the subsea wells to the topside facility (FPU).
  • To support the Company’s Development Team during Project Execution Phase in the engineering, design, manufacturing and testing (performed by Contractor) of subsea production, injection and workover instrumentation and control systems (both subsea and topside on FPU) assuring that the design meets project requirements, applicable standards and engineering best practices, developing Company's know-how in this area.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Internal feasibility and conceptual study for new subsea field development. Prepare the required block flow diagram, subsea schematic, Material Take-Off (MTO), support project service for CAPEX, OPEX, offshore installation method and schedule. 
  • Review subsea engineering documentation submitted by Contractor (i.e. basis of design, subsea distribution schematic drawings, layout, etc.)
  • Site inspection and Interfacing with the Logistic Department and/or Contractor.
  • Offshore assistance during installation and pre-commissioning activities onboard installation vessel and/or FPU.
  • Follow up internal assessment for development and intervention tasks to support the Project and Operation team
  • Follow-up the detail engineering performed by Contractor relevant to subsea production and control systems.
  • Support to offshore installation, commissioning and production start-up.
  • Support for internal Management of Change (MOC) related to subsea operation. 
  • Review operating, isolation, intervention, maintenance philosophies and trouble shooting.
  • Provide technical support for subsea operations, maintenance, inspection, intervention, and IMR campaigns.


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:
  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Marine, Ocean/Offshore, Engineering or equivalent subjects. 
  • Experience:
    • Minimum 8 years of working experience in Oil and Gas development projects.
    • Experience in subsea field development concept and understanding of the subsea flow assurance and topside processing.
    • Experience with brownfield tie-in, existing subsea facilities, flexible flowline installation and subsea control system modification. 
    • Experience in subsea system isolation philosophy including electrical, optical, hydraulic & hydrocarbon.
    • Experience with Subsea Production Systems (SPS), including subsea trees, manifolds, jumpers, flowlines, umbilicals, flying leads, Subsea Control Modules (SCMs), Umbilical Termination Assemblies (UTAs), and associated subsea equipment.
    • Experience working onboard offshore installation vessels during offshore project execution, including installation, commissioning, and Inspection, Maintenance, and Repair (IMR) campaigns.
    • Experience with system integration and interfaces between subsea, topsides, pipelines, controls, and well completion systems.
    • Familiarity with applicable API, ISO, DNV, project-specific standards and specifications.
    • Understanding of subsea system integrity, flow assurance, operability, reliability, and safety requirements. 
  • Training & Certification: T-BOSIET/BOSIET + HUET.
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia
Required Competencies
Technical Competencies:
  • Proven knowledge of subsea trees, manifolds, jumpers, flying leads, UTA, SCM, Pipeline End Termination and Manifold (PLET/PLEM), and associated subsea equipment. 
  • Ability to develop and review subsea system architecture, functional requirements, operating philosophies, system interfaces and design basis.
  • Experience in subsea system isolation philosophy including electrical, optical, hydraulic & hydrocarbon.
  • Understanding of rigid/flexible flowlines, risers, jumpers, connectors, valves and associated mechanical interfaces.
  • Understanding of electro-hydraulic umbilicals, flying leads, termination assemblies, installation requirements. 
  • Working knowledge of subsea flow assurance and topside process.
  • Experience supporting subsea installation, commissioning, System Integration Testing (SIT), offshore testing, intervention and IMR campaigns, including working onboard installation vessels. 
  • Experience with Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), SIT, pre-commissioning and commissioning subsea facilities. 
  • Ability to prepare and review specifications, datasheets, philosophies, system descriptions, interface documents, procedures and technical reports.

Non-Technical Competencies:
  • Problem-solving and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve control system issues during offshore activities.
  • Demonstrates clear and effective communication of technical matters across multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and management.   
  • Exhibit sound engineering decisions based on technical, operational, safety, cost, and schedule considerations.
  • Proven track record of effectively managing interfaces with clients, contractors, installation contractors, and regulatory authorities.
Working Conditions:
  • Jakarta, Indonesia
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas.

Job Title: Senior Rigid Pipeline Engineer


Purpose:

To supervise offshore rigid pipeline installation activities (24”, 4” and 12”), monitor contractor performance, ensure the application of all relevant Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality (HSEQ) and Quality Assurance (QA) procedures, and provide technical support as required.

  • Ensure delivery of the design of subsea pipelines and tie in spools for detailed design projects within timeline and Company and HSE standards. 
  • Check isometrics such as general arrangement, field layout, alignment sheets & approach drawings, tie-in spool design.

  • Provide leadership within discipline in the delivery of subsea projects.

  • Develop weekly progress design activities at Contractor site. 
  • Liaise with the company Transportation & Installation (T&I) engineering coordinator on design activities. 
  • Ensure design and engineering related issues are resolved and communicated to the T&I engineering coordinator.   
  • Ensure request for deviations are communicated to the T&I engineering Coordinator.
  • Record, monitor and control design changes in order to maximize cost efficiency.
  • Review Master Document Register (MDRs) and Material Take-Off (MTOs) for Pipeline.   
  • Provide effective efficient interface and coordinating design inputs with other disciplines i.e SPS, FPSO and installation operations.
  • Interface with the installation contractor during offshore operations.
  • Coordinate Company Inspectors and HSE team.
  • Verify the compliance of installation activities with the relevant HSEQ regulations.


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:
  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Ocean Engineering, or equivalent subjects.

    • Minimum of 15 years of working experience in Oil & Gas industry.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Contract Administration Officer (TPC)
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Contract Administration Officer 


 

Purpose:

To monitor and govern complex contracts related to project development activities within the area of competence throughout the post-award phase, to ensure contractual compliance, commercial protection, and appropriate risk management in accordance with applicable regulatory framework.

General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

Contract Administration & Compliance

·         Ensure effective Contract Administration activities within scope in accordance with applicable Regulatory Framework including Indonesian requirement of PTK-007.

·         Participate in Contract Handover and Kick-Off Meetings, as well as ensure completeness of contractual documentation.

·         Verify that the awarded contractor has supplied all the documentation required and requested under the contract to ensure that all contractual obligations and requirements are fully met in accordance with Regulatory Framework.

·         Monitor Contractor compliance with Contract Terms and Conditions, Scope of Work, Deliverables, Milestones, HSE obligations and Project Schedule identifying and escalating deviations where necessary.

·         Monitor contractual securities, including performance bonds, guarantees, insurance certificates and social security contribution involving, if necessary, all the relevant functions (such as Legal, Insurance, Tax) and ensuring validity throughout contract execution.

·         Support administration of subcontract approvals and contractor compliance reviews.

·         Monitor and maintain a register of contractual obligations, key milestones, critical contractual deliverables, notice periods and other time-bound requirements to ensure timely compliance by both the Contractor and the Company.

 

Commercial Administration

·         Monitor contract expenditure against approved administrative contract values and provide early warning regarding potential budget overruns or commercial exposure.

·         Process payment certification, service entry administration and invoice reviews

·         Liaise with relevant Project Team members to confirm completion status and obtain the Project Manager’s approval and signature.

·         Review the admissibility of the applicability of any compensation events, liquidated damages, contractual remedies or volume discounts provided in the contract;

 

Contract Risk Management

·         Support Contract Holder in identification, assessment, controlling and mitigation of contractual, commercial and schedule risks throughout contract execution, ensuring if necessary, involving all the relevant functions.

·         Maintain Contract Risk Registers and monitor implementation of mitigation actions.

 

Variations, Claims and Disputes

·         Lead and coordinate contract change management activities, including Company Instructions, Variation Orders, and Amendments.

·         Review any requests for changes to the contract and assess any disputes that might arise during contract execution phase by verifying their admissibility and applicability under the terms of the contract.

·         Review the admissibility of any claims and coordinate claims processes, including notifications, analysis, evaluation of evidence, negotiation support and resolution activities.

·         Support dispute avoidance and dispute resolution activities in coordination with all relevant functions such as Procurement, Legal, Technical Functions, HSE etc.

·         Assess contractual entitlement related to extensions of time.

·         Maintain the Variation Order Register and monitor the status and cumulative commercial impact of pending and approved changes to ensure the cost recoverability for Cost Recovery Scheme Contract.

 

Documentation and Traceability

·         Ensure filing/traceability records of contract documents, contractual correspondence, meetings, decisions, notices, claims and variations.

·         Prepare contractual/commercial correspondence for subsequent verification and approval.

·         Review correspondence with contractors on post-award contractual/commercial matters within the area of competence and involving, if necessary, all the relevant functions.

·         Review Contractor minutes of meeting or, where necessary, prepare Company minutes of meeting for subsequent verification and approval.

·         Contributes, if required, to the development, improvement and implementation of Contract Management and Contract Administration strategies, plans, and procedures.

 

 Contractor Performance Management

·         Monitor contractor performance and support issuance of contractor performance evaluations and feedback in accordance with Company procedures.

·         Ensure timely identification and documentation of contractor non-performance or non-compliance.

 

Contract Close-Out

·         Assists Contract Holder in coordination of the complete contract close-out process, including final account settlement, completion certificates, release of contractual securities, closure of claims, capture and document lessons learned/best practices, and preparation of close-out reports.

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·         Support Contract Holder in ensuring compliance with all HSEQ rules and standards established in the Contract, Company Policies, the HSE Integrated Management System and applicable procedures. 

·         Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.

·         Report all incidents.

·         Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.

·         Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

·         Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Law, Engineering or equivalent subjects

·         Experience: Minimum 5 years of working experience in Contract Administration or Contract Management area, including at least 3 years of experience as a Contract Engineer within Oil & Gas industry

·         Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

 

Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

·         Working knowledge of applicable SKK Migas Contracting and Procurement Guidelines, including PTK-007 and their application throughout the contract lifecycle.

·         Advanced knowledge of the contract management/administration process: application of procedures, working instructions and contractual standards in Oil & Gas industry, use and application of methodologies for the management of variations and claims during the contract lifecycle with relevant analysis of impact on costs.

·         Basic knowledge of pre-award activities: Procurement planning and management, Technical Bid Evaluations, Knowledge of various types of contracts and different Procurement Strategies. 

·         Strong knowledge of regulations applicable to contracts and subcontracts (Health Safety and Environment, Safety at worksites, Technical Specifications and standards, Contract Terms and Conditions, International Petroleum Agreements)

·         Cost analysis and purchase pricing – Financial Evaluations – Cost estimating – Budgeting – Cost analysis and control.

 

Non-Technical Competencies:

·         Ability to work with minimum supervision.

·         Systematic thinker and good organizational skills/time management

·         Proven ability to manage multiple contracts, priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

·         Personal and professional integrity

 

Working Conditions:

·         Jakarta, Indonesia

·         Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas

Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.

 

We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:

 

Job Title: Budget Control & Contract Team Leader

 

Purpose:

To manage, coordinate, supervise and ensure logistic operation related plan, contractual process (material and services) and budget requirements are fully addressed and line up with department objectives and targets. Area of responsibilities to include all project of exploration, development and production execution and to ensure the continuity of day-to-day logistic operation in terms of compliance and regulatory fulfilment both internal and external.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Manage and coordinate Contract team to support exploration, development and production operations to ensure all logistic contracts are in place and properly prepared, planned and managed to support operations. Contracts included: Oil Country Tubular Goods (OCTG) and Large Casing Material, Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) Replenishment Inventory Material, Preservation, Shorebase, marine vessels and fuel, aviation, land transportation, surveyor, other logistic support services, etc according to the Company requirements/guidelines and meets the Government regulations. 
  • Plan of contractual aspect for existing and upcoming activities for the fleet strategy and requirement in coordination with the technical expert in logistic Department.
  • Supervise technical bids preparation, process specifications, test and progress reports, and other exhibits that may be required comply to government/local regulations (PTK 007, etc) and Company guidelines.
  • Monitor tender process from bid submission to contract establishment.
  • Perform review and evaluation on the tender document such as Owner’s Estimate (OE), DAJ, Amendment Justification, etc.
  • Perform contract performance audit and establish contract lesson learned list for reference of next contract creation.
  • Liaise between logistic and all stakeholders to coordinate budget preparation, contract review, participate in meetings and discussions, manage and file all documentations and correspondences having a contractual relevance exchanged during project execution with Government authorities/authorities, partners and contractors.
  • Plan and prepare logistic budget of Work Package & Budget (WP&B) and/or Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) preparation and approval by Government authorities, as well as the yearly budget by HQ. Create breakdown to type of the budget (FC/4YP, HQ, Government authorities, etc.).
  • Perform logistic budget monitoring and analysis to ensure the planned budget is in line with the owner estimate and approved budget.
  • Manage budgets and cost between the contract and actual utilization compared with approved budget of yearly or project basis.   
  • Establish expenditure report for management decisions in terms of Free Cash Flow analysis.
  • Act as a liaison between the Company and Government authorities or subcontractors.
  • Supervise Invoice process review, verification and payment process for all related logistic contract services and to ensure the process is in line with Company’s regulation and expectation and within the defined target as per contract.


Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.

    • Employee Induction including HSE Awareness
    • Economics Basic course
    • Economics Advanced course
    • Project Management Basic course
    • Specialist Software Training (Reporting System, SAP, etc).
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia.


Required Competencies

  • E&P management standard workflow and best practices.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Contract Administrator
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.

 

We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: Contract Administrator

 

Purpose:

To coordinate, maintain, and manage contract terms, and services operations (including but not limited to, production, maintenance, asset integrity, subsea operation, engineering operation) of Company facilities in the said scope of department. A Contract Administrator (CA) is a professional who supports Contract Holder (CH) with contract management activities. Contract Administrator activities will be conducted in safe manner with maximizing field production efficiency while minimizing the total maintenance cost (production downtime, spare parts, manpower, etc.) and meet daily production targets whilst complying with company guidelines and legal requirements.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

General:

  • Ensure contract administrator activities are carried out in compliance with all relevant procedures and legal requirements.
  • Manage all aspects of the contracting activities with due diligence, within the technical best practice and provide solutions options and/or recommendations to management in the case of any challenges occurs.
  • Maintain contract documents and data in Contract Management System.
  • Conceive, develop, and deliver techniques, practices, and procedures for contract formation and administration in a manner that best protects company interest.

Pre Award:

  • Conduct commercial evaluations and finalize all contractual terms and conditions to award Contracts for Goods and services, both for normal and/or standard contract, and for high value and complexity one.
  • Conduct requisitions for material and services to meet cost, quantity and quality requirements all in accordance with Company’s Procurement Policies & Procedures.
  • Participate in preparation of contracts & procurement strategies to ensure optimum contracting added value to the company.
  • Coordinate with the professional services and accounting team to ensure the accuracy and validity of contract information. 

Tender Process:

  • Prepare and evaluate pre-qualifications and contract tender package in coordination with user department.

Post Award:

  • Ensure the monitoring of the spend against the Annual Contract Value (ACV).
  • Verify that the Contractor has supplied all the documentation required under the contract to ensure compliance with contractual obligations, continued professional/technical competence, insurance policies, guarantees and subcontract authorizations, making sure that these requirements continue to be met for the duration of the contract.
  • Maintain contact and manages correspondence with the Contractor, ensuring traceability and involving other functions as applicable.
  • If foreseen in the contract transmit the duly authorized Call-offs to the Contractor, to trigger the execution of the services/work or the delivery of the requested goods.
  • Assist the User Unit Manager in raising Purchase Requisition (PR) to Procurement in accordance with the applicable Company’s procedure along with the support of its related function.
  • Submit the complete PR i.e.: Owner Estimate (OE), Scope of Work (SOW), HSE Risk Assessment, Plan of Development (POD), Work Plan and Budget (WP&B), Authority For Expenditures (AFE), Procurement List (for value ≥500KUSD), if applicable professional justification for Exceptional Direct Appointment (for value ≥20KUSD) and also amendment justification (if any).
  • Ensure that the CH and other key staff in the user department are notified of any irregularities identified during the execution of the contract, also to enable the issue of appropriate feedback.
  • Analyse any requests for changes to the contract, liaising with Procurement as required.
  • Carry out the relevant checks on Variation Order Proposals and prepare the Variation Orders.
  • Manage any disputes/claims arising during the contract execution, in particular verifying their admissibility under the terms of the contract.
  • Verify the applicability of any penalties or volume discounts provided for in the contract.
  • Prepare the feedback form for performance evaluation of the Contractor.
  • File all documents related to the management of the contract.
  • Responsible for contract change management and perform and/or review contract payment and inventory audits.
  • Ensure contract renewals are initiated in a timely manner.
  • Lead investigation and rectify contract problems.
  • Coordinate with finance staff to ensure proper billing and collection of contractual revenue.
  • Resolve contract payment disputes and confer with contractors and other divisions concerning contract payments and compliance.
  • Conduct contract Close out and Lessons Learn.

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

  • Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures.
  • Report all incidents.
  • Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards.
  • Participate in HSE related initiatives.
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in relevant fields related to Contract Administrator roles.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 5 years of working experience, including a minimum of 4 years of experience in managing Production Sharing Contract (PSC) project contracts. A minimum of 2 years of working experience in a petrochemical company is preferred.
  • Training & Certification:
    • Employee Induction including HSE Awareness
    • PTK-007
    • T-BOSIET (1st time) or T-FOET (refreshment)
  • Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa Indonesia

Required Competencies

Technical Competencies:

  • Understand and are familiar with international contractual formats.
  • Thorough understanding of the commodity markets and price trends, various grades, qualities, and variations in material, supplies, and equipment.
  • Negotiation skills and the ability to understand the negotiable parameters in line with Company targets.

Non-Technical Competencies:

  • Demonstrates integrity & strong commitment to ethical values 
  • Result oriented 
  • Value Creation Focus 
  • Teamwork & cooperation 
  • Initiative 
  • Analytical thinking 
  • Proactive in information gathering 
  • High attention to detail and orderliness 
  • Confident 
  • Ability to work effectively in a team 

Working Conditions:

  • Jakarta, Indonesia
  • Possibility for business travel to other Company’s premises or field areas.

title: Prime Natuna EP - Fixed Infrastructure Sr. Technical Safety Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for Designing Technical Safety system for Fixed Infrastructure Project and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation.

Required to be mobilized to support the execution of Fixed Infrastructure FEED work, which is planned to commence in Oct’26. Involvement of a Sr. Technical Safety Engineer is critical to ensure readiness of Technical Safety Engineering Activities, including Safety Design Requirements, Major Accident Hazard assessment, SECE requirements, and required Process Safety Studies. Timely mobilization will ensure that Safety-Critical requirements are properly incorporated into the design from the early stage of FEED, while minimizing the risks of design gaps, late safety-driven changes, and rework during FEED and subsequent EPCI phases.

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence: 

  • ​​Deliver Technical Safety deliverables for Fixed Infrastructure scope.  
  • ​Establishing the Implementation of INBU HSE Technical Safety Program through an effective approach, 
  • ​Empowering the Mandatory Control Framework of MAH concept and stimulus the Technical Safety Performance Evaluation and identify Gaps, 
  • ​Strategically for evaluating the process for managing of MAH risks of the INBU, 
  • ​Hosting the Technical Safety Corporate and Regulatory requirements with aligned to Management direction and requirements 
  • ​Ensuring the technical healthiness and integrity of the SECEs. 
  • ​Delivering the Compliance process of SECE Verification Scheme process into Operation and Development Department 
  • ​Accountable for Validating to all Critical Process Safety Information at all Worksites 
  • ​Assuring to Deliver the analysis of Technical Safety Findings and Interventions which covering the aspects of Identify Root Causes, Formulate Intervention Strategies and Review intervention plans to strengthen HSE Control of Work.

title: Medco E & P Indonesia - Electrical & Instrument Supervisor (TPC)
raw_description:
Medco E & P Indonesia is looking for an experienced Electrical & Instrument Supervisor to join our team through a Third-Party Contract (TPC). In this role, you will contribute to Sakakemang PSC, an upstream oil and gas project located in South Sumatra and operated by MedcoEnergi. Currently in the development phase, the project is progressing toward First Gas/First Production, with start-up targeted for Q3 2027.


In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing, supervising, and assuring all electrical and instrumentation construction activities at site to ensure safe, compliant, and high-quality execution in accordance with Operator standards, approved engineering designs, contractual requirements, and applicable international codes. The role provides field-level technical authority and HSE leadership, ensuring EPC contractors and subcontractors execute E&I works correctly, safely, and in alignment with project readiness for commissioning and start-up.


Key Responsibilities



Electrical & Instrumentation Construction Supervision

  • Supervise and monitor all electrical and instrumentation construction activities, including:
    • Electrical equipment installation (LV/MV/HV as applicable)
    • Cable tray, cable pulling, termination, and glanding
    • Earthing and lightning protection systems
    • Instrument installation, tubing, and impulse lines
    • Control systems, field instruments, and package equipment interfaces
  • Ensure all works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, datasheets, installation procedures, and method statements.
  • Verify construction sequencing supports safe execution, testing, and commissioning readiness.
  • Identify execution issues, design deviations, or constructability concerns and escalate to Construction Management and Engineering teams.



Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

  • Enforce Operator HSE standards, life-saving rules, and procedures at all times.
  • Ensure all E&I construction works are performed under valid work permits, risk assessments and approved method statements.
  • Actively participate in toolbox talks, safety walks, audits, and inspections.
  • Report and follow up on HSE observations, near-misses, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • Promote a strong safety leadership culture.



Quality Assurance & Control

  • Ensure E&I construction complies with:
    • International codes and standards
    • Hazardous area requirements 
    • Operator engineering and quality standards
  • Coordinate with QA/QC and inspection teams for inspections, testing, and acceptance.
  • Verify installation quality, workmanship, calibration, loop checks, and system integrity.
  • Ensure timely rectification and close-out of punch items and non-conformities.



Contractor & Interface Management

  • Supervise EPC contractors and E&I subcontractors to ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and contractual obligations.
  • Monitor contractor manpower, tools, test equipment, and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate E&I interfaces with mechanical, piping, civil, telecom, and commissioning teams.
  • Support resolution of site execution conflicts and interface issues.



Schedule, Progress & Cost Control

  • Monitor daily and weekly E&I construction progress against approved schedules.
  • Validate contractor-reported progress through field verification.
  • Provide accurate progress input to Construction Superintendent / Construction Manager and Project Controls team.
  • Escalate schedule risks, environmental constraints, or stakeholder-related issues affecting pipeline works.



Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and submit daily and weekly E&I construction reports, including progress, HSE, manpower, and key issues.
  • Maintain site records, inspection logs, and construction documentation.
  • Participate in site coordination meetings, progress meetings, and HSE meetings.



Commissioning & Handover Support

  • Support electrical and instrumentation pre-commissioning and commissioning activities such as:
  • Electrical testing and energization
  • Instrument calibration and loop checking
  • Control system integration and functional testing
  • Participate in system walk-downs, mechanical completion, and handover to Operations.
  • Ensure E&I systems are safe, complete, and ready for start-up.
  • Verify completeness and accuracy of handover documentation.
raw_requirements:
• Minimum bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering or related discipline.
  • Minimum 13 years of experience in Electrical & Instrument construction project, installation, or supervision within oil & gas projects.
  • Proven experience with minimum 2 years’ experience as Field Supervisor, E&I Supervisor, or Construction Supervisor role.
  • Strong technical knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems in industrial facilities.
  • Previous experience working for Operators/Owners is essential. 
  • Strong technical knowledge of E&I construction and installation practices.
  • Good understanding of HSE management in oil & gas construction environments. 
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, loop diagrams, layouts and construction schedules. 
  • Strong field supervision, coordination, and problem-solving skills. 
  • English B2 (Upper Intermediate) Level.

Disclaimer: The selected candidate will be engaged on a contract basis through a third-party company appointed by MedcoEnergi. This role supports MedcoEnergi's projects and business objectives, and is delivered in alignment with the Company's standards, governance, and operational requirements.

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know Our Team

The OCO Office's People Program Management Office helps Grab solve complex organisational challenges and turn ideas into practical outcomes.

Our work sits at the intersection of people, technology, and operations. Every programme brings a new problem to solve, a new frontier to explore, or an opportunity to improve how Grab works. We continually challenge our own standards, experiment with better ways of working, and build solutions that make a lasting difference.

If you enjoy creating clarity from complexity, questioning the status quo, and helping teams deliver meaningful change, you will find plenty to keep you busy here.

Get to Know the Role

As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead complex, cross-functional programmes across multiple domains. You will drive business outcomes via the projects you manage, align stakeholders, track risks and dependencies.

You will work closely with People, Technology, Engineering, Product, Operations, and country teams. You will also help strengthen PMO practices, reporting, governance, and delivery standards across the organisation.

At Grab, we're committed to enabling those closest to the problem to solve it using AI, and this extends to how we run our programmes. As a Senior Project Manager, you're expected to actively use AI tools to accelerate planning, reporting, risk analysis, and documentation and to bring an experimental mindset to identifying where AI and automation can remove friction from delivery work, while applying sound judgement on confidentiality and data handling.

This is an onsite role based in Indonesia, reporting to the Manager, Program Management. If you enjoy bringing order to complicated work and making progress visible, we would like to hear from you.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Coordinate multiple workstreams across People, Technology, Engineering, Product, Operations, and regional teams to deliver agreed outcomes.

Establish and maintain project governance, including status reporting, RAID logs, decision registers, steering forums, and escalation paths.

Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methods based on the needs and complexity of each programme.

Identify delivery risks and dependencies early, drive mitigation actions, and escalate decisions that could affect timelines or outcomes.

Use GenAI tools to improve project planning, status reporting, meeting documentation, risk analysis, and workflow efficiency while applying appropriate confidentiality and review controls.

Identify opportunities to improve PMO processes, templates, reporting standards, and delivery practices across the People Team.

title: Sr Officer-ERP System Support
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To act as the primary Person In Charge (PIC) for the ERP platform on the IOH side, serving as the key functional and technical point of contact between business users, IT, and the Managed Services Partner (vendor/mitra). This role is responsible for day-to-day platform ownership — including business requirement coordination, master data and configuration integrity, and cross-module functional oversight — as well as governing the partner's delivery of L1, L2, and L3 Application Managed Services (AMS) across the ERP ecosystem, System Integration, on prem/cloud infrastructure related, middleware, ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, effective Change Request (T&M) delivery, and adherence to IOH governance, reporting, security, and service acceptance (BAST) standards.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the single Point of Contact (PIC) for ERP system matters on the IOH side; gather and consolidate business requirements from process owners; prioritize and validate enhancement/CR proposals prior to partner execution; safeguard master data, Chart of Accounts, and configuration integrity across modules; provide functional guidance to business users on system usage and process alignment, system integration, and infrastructure utilization awareness.
  • Act as the primary IOH counterpart for the ERP Ecosystem Managed Services Partner; monitor day-to-day delivery of L1/L2/L3 support across ERP ecosystem, Surrounding system, system integration, infra utilization, license monitoring; ensure the partner operates within the agreed operating model, service window, and escalation matrix.
  • Monitor and validate the partner's compliance to SLA targets (response/resolution time per P1-P4, System and integration uptime, First Time Fix Rate); review incident trend and aging-ticket reports; drive corrective action for SLA breaches.
  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.
  • Coordinate impact assessment, regression testing, and stabilization activities for ERP system mandatory quarterly cloud updates; ensure partner readiness and risk mitigation prior to patch deployment.
  • Lead and/or participate in daily operational standups, weekly service reviews, the monthly Executive Steering Committee, and the quarterly Patch & Strategy Alignment forum with the partner; consolidate reporting for management visibility.
  • Ensure the partner adheres to IOH IAM/MFA access standards, data confidentiality requirements, and change governance (no production change without an approved CR and roll-back plan); maintain audit evidence of access and change activities.
  • Validate monthly service evidence (SLA summary, RCA/CAPA, ticket tracker, UAT sign-offs) submitted by the partner and process monthly BAST acceptance in line with IOH governance standards.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

title: Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Jambi)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Jambi)

Daftar Sekarang

Jambi, Jambi City, Jambi, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengidentifikasi dan mendapatkan prospek (lead) baru serta membangun basis pelanggan yang berkelanjutan.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola pipeline prospek untuk secara konsisten mencapai target bulanan.

Secara proaktif mencari prospek baru melalui berbagai strategi pendekatan langsung.

Mengelola seluruh proses penjualan, mulai dari kontak awal dengan prospek hingga proses penutupan penjualan.

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan prospek, serta memastikan keterlibatan mereka selama seluruh siklus penjualan.

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Jambi.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

Daftar Sekarang

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Sumatra Utara

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

title: Searah Muara Bakau - HSE Management System & Performance Manager
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


We are looking for qualified personnel with high motivation, initiative, and integrity to fill the following position:


Job Title: HSE Management System and Performance Manager


Purpose:

To act as a focal point for Management System Performance Assessments (MSPA) issues, provide advice and support to ensure compliance with regulation, company policies and industry practices.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Develop Company SEQ 4 Year Plan on MSPA aspect.
  • Develop SEQ Annual Plan and Budget on MSPA aspect.
  • Ensure the Development, implementation, and monitoring of HSE Plan on MSPA aspect.
  • Report MSPA periodically to Company’s SEQ Management.
  • Coordinate to maintain the record of Liaise with Authorities including the Company commitment.
  • Coordinate to maintain the record of compliance to regulations and Company requirement and policies.
  • Coordinate to maintain the Emergency Response Plan.
  • Coordinate implementation of Contractor HSE Management.
  • Coordinate to maintain the HSE training program.
  • Coordinate HSE audit/assessment to measure the HSE Performance.
  • Provide support and advise to project team on related MSPA issues.
  • Coordinate the implementation of Company HSE MSG, OSHAS 18001, ISO 45001 & ISO 14001 Management System.
  • Develop of audit scheme and conduct audit as per plan.
  • Develop and maintain the HSE competency requirement.
  • Champion on Company CI program for HSE.
  • Develop the concept of HSE program for Indonesia and site level.
  • Ensure to maintain and update register of Contractor HSE evaluation and assessment.

raw_description:
Responsible for designing Electrical System for FPSO Project Development and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation.

  • ​Provide electrical load list, schematic diagrams, single line diagrams, cable schedules and MTO using Smart Plant Electrical. 
  • ​Perform power system studies (short circuit, coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics) using ETAP. 
  • ​Perform Insulation coordination and transient study using PSCAD or EMTP software. 
  • ​Perform calculations for equipment sizing, UPS, cable sizing, lighting, grounding and heat tracing. 
  • ​Prepare specifications, data sheets, cable schedules and interface schedules. 
  • ​Produce material take-off and material requisition. 
  • ​Review Bids and Technical Evaluation. 
  • ​Design and checking of single lines, schematics and wiring diagrams, area classification, grounding, panel/cable schedules, equipment layout, cable layout, tray layout, lighting and installation details without supervision. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 3D model with the other disciplines. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 2D AutoCAD/ Micro-station drawings. 
  • ​Visit construction/plant sites and fabrication shops during design phase on as required basis. 
  • ​Ensure construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities for electrical systems are delivered safely as per company requirement. 
  • ​Develop electrical engineering report for Project Development Management in a timely manner 
  • ​Performs non-routine tasks and attends such meetings as directed from time to time by Project Development Sr. Manager as opportunity presents in order to meet Company objectives.  Ensures that all relevant managers and subordinates are kept informed of all major opportunities, developments, problems or potential problems, which will impact upon the Business.
  • Indonesian Nationality
raw_requirements:

  • ​​​​​​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. 
  • ​Min. 15 years working experience as an electrical engineer for offshore floating infrastructure within oil and gas industry, preferably experience in project stage. 
  • ​Experienced in electrical design using Smart Plant Electrical or other electrical design software. 
  • ​ Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering within the oil & gas industry, with strong exposure to offshore floating infrastructure projects, particularly FPSO, preferably covering project development, FEED, detailed engineering, and execution phases.
  • Proven experience in electrical system design and engineering for offshore floating facilities, including preparation and review of electrical engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Experience in construction, fabrication, pre-commissioning, and start-up support for electrical systems in offshore facilities is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant electrical engineering tools/software.

Special Skills / Knowledge:

       • In-depth expertise in detailed engineering and design of electrical power systems for offshore floating facilities, particularly FPSO, covering power generation and distribution, electrical      equipment, cabling, grounding, lighting, UPS, and heat tracing systems.

      • Comprehensive knowledge of international electrical codes, standards, and hazardous-area requirements applicable to offshore facilities, including ANSI, IEEE, IEC, NEC, NEMA, CSA, UL, API, and relevant area-classification requirements.

      • Strong multidisciplinary interface and constructability capability for FPSO electrical systems, including coordination with other engineering disciplines, 3D model reviews, vendor technical evaluations, and support during fabrication, construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up
